sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，一名女性的遗体在加利福尼亚州的一个葡萄园中被发现。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她遭到了斩首，体内的血液已被排干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心机，试图隐瞒她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为“无名氏”。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 后来，侦探们终于查明了她的名字——艾达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 然而，确认她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案变得更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《艾达》是“案件档案呈现”系列的新作，现已在各大播客平台上线。

sentences.en: Today's episode involves crimes against children, and won't be suitable for all listeners.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目涉及针对儿童的犯罪，可能不适合所有听众。

sentences.en: 28-year-old Dora Fronczak was elated when she gave birth to a healthy baby boy on Sunday, April 26, 1964, in Chicago's Michael Reis Hospital.
sentences.zh: 1964年4月26日，星期日，28岁的多拉·弗龙恰克在芝加哥迈克尔·里斯医院产下一名健康的男婴，她欣喜若狂。

sentences.en: Ten months earlier, in the same ward of the same hospital, Dora had gone through labour for the first time.
sentences.zh: 十个月前，多拉曾在同一家医院的同一个病房经历过第一次分娩。

sentences.en: That child, Dora's first son, had been stillborn.
sentences.zh: 那个孩子，也就是多拉的第一个儿子，是个死胎。

sentences.en: But this time, all had gone well.
sentences.zh: 但这一次，一切都很顺利。

sentences.en: Dora and her husband, Chasta, named their baby boy, Paul Joseph Fronczak.
sentences.zh: 多拉和丈夫查斯塔给他们的男婴取名为保罗·约瑟夫·弗龙恰克。

sentences.en: Paul weighed seven pounds, two ounces, and he had an olive complexion and dark hair, just like his parents.
sentences.zh: 保罗重七磅二盎司，肤色偏橄榄色，头发乌黑，就像他的父母一样。

sentences.en: At around 1.40pm on Monday, April 27, Dora lay in her hospital bed, nursing Paul.
sentences.zh: 4月27日，星期一，下午1点40分左右，多拉躺在病床上给保罗喂奶。

sentences.en: Chasta was at work and would be joining them later that day.
sentences.zh: 查斯塔当时在上班，稍后会过来陪他们。

sentences.en: As Dora cradled her one-day-old son, a middle-aged nurse walked into the room.
sentences.zh: 正当多拉抱着出生仅一天的儿子时，一名中年护士走进了房间。

sentences.en: She was wearing the standard nurse's uniform of the day, a white smock dress with white shoes and stockings.
sentences.zh: 她穿着当时标准的护士制服：一件白色罩衫式连衣裙，搭配白鞋和白长袜。

sentences.en: A white hairnet covered her greying brown hair.
sentences.zh: 她那灰褐色的头发上罩着一个白色发网。

sentences.en: In a calm, authoritative voice, the nurse told Dora,
sentences.zh: 护士用冷静而权威的声音对多拉说：

sentences.en: One of the paediatricians wants to examine your son.
sentences.zh: “儿科医生想给你的儿子做个检查。”

sentences.en: I need to take him now.
sentences.zh: “我现在得把他带走。”

sentences.en: Dora found it slightly odd that a doctor would interrupt her baby's feeding time to perform an examination, but assumed they had their reasons.
sentences.zh: 多拉觉得医生在喂奶时间打断孩子有点奇怪，但她认为对方肯定有他们的理由。

sentences.en: She handed Paul over to the nurse.
sentences.zh: 于是她把保罗交给了护士。

sentences.en: He was swaddled in a white cotton blanket, and the nurse held him tightly to her as she left the room.
sentences.zh: 他被包裹在一条白色棉毯里，护士离开房间时紧紧地抱着他。

sentences.en: Ten minutes later, at 1.50pm, a nurse named Martha Vinson headed to room 418 to collect Paul Fronczak from his mother.
sentences.zh: 十分钟后，即下午1点50分，一名叫玛莎·文森的护士前往418病房，准备从多拉那里接回保罗·弗龙恰克。

sentences.en: Paul had been taken to Dora for feeding 40 minutes earlier and would be ready to go back to the nursery by now.
sentences.zh: 保罗在40分钟前被送到多拉那里喂奶，现在应该可以送回育婴室了。

sentences.en: When Martha entered the twin room that Dora shared with another new mother, she was surprised to see Paul was already gone.
sentences.zh: 当玛莎走进多拉与另一位新妈妈合住的双人病房时，她惊讶地发现保罗已经不见了。

sentences.en: Where's your baby?
sentences.zh: “你的孩子呢？”

sentences.en: I need to take him back to the nursery, Martha said.
sentences.zh: “我得把他带回育婴室，”玛莎说。

sentences.en: Dora explained that another nurse had already taken him.
sentences.zh: 多拉解释说，刚才已经有另一位护士把他带走了。

sentences.en: Martha immediately knew that something was wrong.
sentences.zh: 玛莎立刻意识到出事了。

sentences.en: She was the nurse assigned to the hospital's newborn nursery, and no one else had any cause to take Paul.
sentences.zh: 她是负责医院新生儿育婴室的护士，其他人根本没有理由带走保罗。

sentences.en: Not wanting to alarm Dora, however, Martha said nothing.
sentences.zh: 不过，为了不惊动多拉，玛莎什么也没说。

sentences.en: She calmly left the room, then rushed to notify the hospital's chief of security.
sentences.zh: 她冷静地走出房间，然后匆忙去通知医院的保安主管。

sentences.en: Every other staff member in the maternity ward was asked if they knew who the mystery nurse was.
sentences.zh: 产科病房里的每一位工作人员都被问及是否认识那位神秘护士。

sentences.en: A young nurse's aide said she had seen the woman hurrying down the corridor with Paul ten minutes earlier.
sentences.zh: 一名年轻的护士助理说，十分钟前她看到那个女人抱着保罗匆匆走过走廊。

sentences.en: Another nurse had seen her go into a stairwell with the baby.
sentences.zh: 另一名护士看到她抱着孩子进了楼梯间。

sentences.en: It was clear that the woman had not really been a nurse.
sentences.zh: 很明显，那个女人根本不是护士。

sentences.en: Nobody at the hospital knew her identity, and although she had on the typical nurse's uniform,
sentences.zh: 医院里没人知道她的身份，尽管她穿着典型的护士制服，

sentences.en: she wasn't wearing the white cap that all the other nurses at the Michael Rees Hospital wore.
sentences.zh: 但她并没有戴迈克尔·里斯医院所有其他护士都戴的那种白色护士帽。

sentences.en: Over the next hour, the hospital was searched from top to bottom.
sentences.zh: 接下来的一个小时里，医院进行了地毯式搜查。

sentences.en: But it appeared that the woman and Paul Fronzak were long gone.
sentences.zh: 但那个女人和保罗·弗龙恰克似乎早已不见踪影。

sentences.en: This was confirmed when a laboratory assistant from the hospital's pathology unit said that he had seen the woman exit the building with Paul in her arms,
sentences.zh: 医院病理科的一名实验室助理证实了这一点，他说他看到那个女人抱着保罗走出了大楼，

sentences.en: then walk away down 29th Street.
sentences.zh: 然后沿着29街走远了。

sentences.en: At 2.45pm, just over one hour after the woman had taken Paul, hospital staff called the Chicago Police Department to report a kidnapping.
sentences.zh: 下午2点45分，也就是那个女人带走保罗一个多小时后，医院工作人员致电芝加哥警察局报案称发生了绑架。

sentences.en: The case immediately went to the top of the department's liSt.
sentences.zh: 该案立即被列为警局的头号要案。

sentences.en: Police issued an all-points bulletin and ordered a doorknock on every property in the ten blocks surrounding the hospital.
sentences.zh: 警方发布了全城通缉令，并下令对医院周围十个街区内的每一处房产进行逐户排查。

sentences.en: Two lieutenants, six sergeants, several patrol officers, and four detectives from the Homicide Division were all assigned to the case, along with nine FBI agents.
sentences.zh: 两名中尉、六名警长、几名巡警、四名凶杀组侦探以及九名联邦调查局特工都被指派负责此案。

sentences.en: The task of notifying Paul's parents also fell to law enforcement.
sentences.zh: 通知保罗父母的任务也落到了执法部门身上。

sentences.en: Chester Fronzak worked as a machinist at a factory and that morning he had gone into work as a proud new father.
sentences.zh: 切斯特·弗龙恰克在一家工厂当机械师，那天早上他还是个自豪的新手爸爸，去上班了。

sentences.en: He had taken a box of cigars to hand out to colleagues in celebration of Paul's birth.
sentences.zh: 他带了一盒雪茄，准备分发给同事，庆祝保罗的出生。

sentences.en: At around 3pm, the police called Chester's workplace and told him over the phone,
sentences.zh: 下午3点左右，警方打通了切斯特的工作电话，在电话里告诉他：

sentences.en: The desperate search for Paul Fronzak had been kept a secret from Dora as hospital staff didn't want to alarm her.
sentences.zh: 对保罗·弗龙恰克的搜寻工作一直对多拉保密，因为医院工作人员不想惊动她。

sentences.en: Chester was the one who had to break the news to her.
sentences.zh: 最后是切斯特不得不把这个消息告诉她。

sentences.en: He knelt by her bed and held her hand as he told her their son had been taken.
sentences.zh: 他跪在床边，握着她的手，告诉她他们的儿子被带走了。

sentences.en: At the same time, technicians from Chicago's PD's crime lab were dispatched to Dora's hospital room so it could be fingerprinted and photographed.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，芝加哥警局犯罪实验室的技术人员被派往多拉的病房，以便提取指纹并进行拍照。

sentences.en: Investigators questioned Dora, who was distraught.
sentences.zh: 调查人员询问了心烦意乱的多拉。

sentences.en: She told them she hadn't gotten a good look at the kidnapper, but she revealed that the woman's visit to her room that afternoon hadn't been the first time Dora had seen her.
sentences.zh: 她说她没看清绑匪的长相，但她透露，那天下午那个女人来病房并不是多拉第一次见到她。

sentences.en: Hours earlier, at about 9.30am, Dora had been giving Paul his morning feed when the woman in the nurse's uniform walked in.
sentences.zh: 几个小时前，大约上午9点30分，多拉正在给保罗喂早奶，那个穿护士制服的女人就走了进来。

sentences.en: She had walked over to Dora's bed and lifted the blue cotton blanket that was wrapped around Paul, exposing his face.
sentences.zh: 她走到多拉床边，掀开了包裹在保罗身上的蓝色棉毯，露出了他的脸。

sentences.en: She had stared at Paul for a long moment.
sentences.zh: 她盯着保罗看了好一会儿。

sentences.en: Then she covered him with the blanket again and left the room.
sentences.zh: 然后她又用毯子把他盖好，离开了房间。

sentences.en: She never uttered a word.
sentences.zh: 她自始至终一言未发。

sentences.en: Dora's roommate Joyce remembered that earlier incident as well, and, like Dora, she'd thought the woman was a nurse.
sentences.zh: 多拉的室友乔伊斯也记得那次早些时候的插曲，和多拉一样，她也以为那个女人是护士。

sentences.en: She told investigators that nothing about it had seemed strange at the time, except for the fact that the woman hadn't spoken.
sentences.zh: 她告诉调查人员，当时并没有觉得有什么奇怪，除了那个女人没说话这一点。

sentences.en: Joyce had thought the woman had a rather cold demeanour, stating,
sentences.zh: 乔伊斯觉得那个女人的神情相当冷漠，她说：

sentences.en: I didn't get the impression that she was a motherly, kindly sort of woman.
sentences.zh: “我没觉得她是个慈祥、友善的女人。”

sentences.en: Multiple other witnesses were able to provide a detailed description of the woman.
sentences.zh: 其他多名目击者能够提供该女子的详细描述。

sentences.en: She was reported as being white, between 35 and 45 years old, about 5 foot 5 inches tall, and approximately 145 pounds.
sentences.zh: 据报告，她是一名白人女性，年龄在35到45岁之间，身高约5英尺5英寸，体重约145磅。

sentences.en: Her brown hair was greying and she had a ruddy complexion with red cheeks.
sentences.zh: 她那棕色的头发里夹杂着灰发，面色红润，脸颊发红。

sentences.en: Other women staying in the maternity ward had also encountered her.
sentences.zh: 住在产科病房的其他女性也遇到过她。

sentences.en: Earlier that same morning, she had entered the room next door to Dora's, where two expectant mothers were staying.
sentences.zh: 就在当天早些时候，她进入了多拉隔壁的房间，那里住着两位待产的孕妇。

sentences.en: When they asked the kidnapper what she wanted, she told them she was from the hospital's eye, ear, nose and throat department.
sentences.zh: 当她们问绑匪想干什么时，她说她是医院五官科的。

sentences.en: Then she quickly left.
sentences.zh: 然后她很快就离开了。

sentences.en: Another woman who was staying in room 425 had also received a visit from the kidnapper.
sentences.zh: 住在425病房的另一位女性也曾遭到绑匪的“拜访”。

sentences.en: The kidnapper had quickly inspected the woman's newborn baby, as she had done with Paul Fronzak.
sentences.zh: 绑匪像对待保罗·弗龙恰克那样，迅速检查了那名女子的新生儿。

sentences.en: Not only had the kidnapper spent at least four hours that day wandering around the maternity ward, she had been seen there the day before as well.
sentences.zh: 绑匪不仅那天在产科病房游荡了至少四个小时，前一天也有人看到她在那里出现。

sentences.en: One of the hospital's cleaners said that a woman matching her description had approached and offered to help fold linens.
sentences.zh: 医院的一名清洁工说，一个外貌特征相符的女人曾走过来，主动提出帮忙折叠床单。

sentences.en: This had struck the cleaner as a bit strange.
sentences.zh: 这让清洁工觉得有点奇怪。

sentences.en: Nurses didn't usually help out with the laundry.
sentences.zh: 护士通常不会帮忙做洗衣房的工作。

sentences.en: But she hadn't thought enough of the incident to say anything until she heard about Paul Fronzak's kidnapping.
sentences.zh: 但她当时没把这事放在心上，直到听说保罗·弗龙恰克被绑架的消息。

sentences.en: None of the hospital staff knew or recognised the kidnapper.
sentences.zh: 医院工作人员中没人认识或见过这个绑匪。

sentences.en: But during her time there, she'd gained knowledge about the building's layout and the schedules of the maternity ward nurses.
sentences.zh: 但在她逗留期间，她已经摸清了建筑布局和产科护士的排班表。

sentences.en: It was evident to investigators that the kidnapper had been trawling the maternity ward in search of an infant to steal.
sentences.zh: 调查人员显然认为，绑匪一直在产科病房徘徊，寻找可以偷走的新生儿。

sentences.en: Perhaps she'd thought that by helping to fold linen, she could gain access to the nursery, where all the babies were kept when not with their mothers.
sentences.zh: 也许她以为通过帮忙折叠床单，就能进入育婴室，那里存放着所有不在母亲身边的婴儿。

sentences.en: When this plan had failed, she'd decided to take a baby from a hospital room instead.
sentences.zh: 当这个计划失败后，她决定改从病房里带走一个婴儿。

sentences.en: They had no idea why she had ultimately settled on Dora and Chester Fronzak's son.
sentences.zh: 他们完全不知道她为什么最终盯上了多拉和切斯特·弗龙恰克的儿子。

sentences.en: The Chicago Police Department contacted local taxi companies and asked them to broadcast an alert to their drivers about the kidnapping.
sentences.zh: 芝加哥警察局联系了当地的出租车公司，要求他们向司机广播有关绑架案的警报。

sentences.en: When 34-year-old cab driver Lee Kelsey heard the message, he immediately phoned the police.
sentences.zh: 当34岁的出租车司机李·凯尔西听到这条消息时，他立即给警方打了电话。

sentences.en: Lee had been parked outside Michael Rees Hospital on the afternoon of Monday April 27, hoping for a customer.
sentences.zh: 4月27日星期一那天下午，李把车停在迈克尔·里斯医院外，希望能拉到乘客。

sentences.en: The cab stand where he was waiting had a telephone where bookings came through.
sentences.zh: 他等待的出租车候车点有一部用于接单的电话。

sentences.en: It rang and Lee answered it.
sentences.zh: 电话响了，李接了起来。

sentences.en: A woman on the other end told him she was inside the hospital's butler building and needed a cab shortly.
sentences.zh: 电话那头的女人告诉他，她在医院的巴特勒大楼里，很快需要一辆出租车。

sentences.en: Confused, Lee told her there was no butler building.
sentences.zh: 李很困惑，告诉她根本没有巴特勒大楼。

sentences.en: The woman clarified by saying she was just south of the main building and on her way down.
sentences.zh: 女人解释说她在主楼南边，正准备下楼。

sentences.en: She would meet him outside when she got there and told him to, quote,
sentences.zh: 她说她到那儿后会在外面和他会合，并告诉他，引用原话：

sentences.en: Look for a nurse.
sentences.zh: “找一个护士。”

sentences.en: Lee drove around the corner to 29th Street and waited.
sentences.zh: 李开车绕过拐角来到29街等待。

sentences.en: Three minutes later, a woman in a nurse's uniform appeared.
sentences.zh: 三分钟后，一个穿着护士制服的女人出现了。

sentences.en: She was carrying a baby swaddled in a blanket.
sentences.zh: 她怀里抱着一个用毯子包裹的婴儿。

sentences.en: She perfectly matched the description of the kidnapper that would be issued later that day.
sentences.zh: 她与当天晚些时候发布的绑匪描述完全吻合。

sentences.en: The kidnapper asked Lee to take her south to 35th Street and Union Avenue.
sentences.zh: 绑匪让李把她载到南边的35街和联合大道路口。

sentences.en: He dropped her off there, then continued on his way.
sentences.zh: 他在那里把她放下，然后继续赶路。

sentences.en: Lee didn't see where the woman had gone after that.
sentences.zh: 李没看到她下车后去了哪里。

sentences.en: He was sure he had picked up the woman once before.
sentences.zh: 他确信自己以前载过这个女人一次。

sentences.en: On that occasion, he'd collected her at 35th and Wallace Streets, then dropped her at a restaurant.
sentences.zh: 那次，他在35街和华莱士街接到了她，然后把她送到了一家餐馆。

sentences.en: He had returned her to the 35th and Wallace area later on.
sentences.zh: 后来他又把她送回了35街和华莱士街区域。

sentences.en: Lee told the police he didn't have an address for her, but it seemed that was her neighbourhood.
sentences.zh: 李告诉警方他不知道她的住址，但看起来那是她住的街区。

sentences.en: Chicago PD dispatched several officers to search the 35th Street vicinity, but the trail went cold.
sentences.zh: 芝加哥警局派出多名警官搜查35街附近，但线索中断了。

sentences.en: Soon, the entirety of Chicago was being searched for baby Paul Fronzak.
sentences.zh: 很快，整个芝加哥都在搜寻婴儿保罗·弗龙恰克。

sentences.en: It was the largest manhunt the city had ever seen.
sentences.zh: 这是该市有史以来最大规模的搜捕行动。

sentences.en: By the end of the first day, roughly 200 police officers and FBI special agents had covered Chicago's south side, searching 600 homes and questioning more than 1,000 people.
sentences.zh: 第一天结束时，大约200名警察和联邦调查局特工已经搜查了芝加哥南区，排查了600户人家，询问了1000多人。

sentences.en: In the days that followed, over 2,600 hospital employees were interviewed, and hundreds of registered nurses had their files examined by investigators.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的几天里，超过2600名医院员工接受了采访，调查人员还检查了数百名注册护士的档案。

sentences.en: Detectives were working off the assumption that the kidnapper might have been a nurse who had lost a child or been unable to have one.
sentences.zh: 侦探们推测，绑匪可能是一名失去过孩子或无法生育的护士。

sentences.en: Motivated by the desire to have a baby, she had decided to steal a newborn.
sentences.zh: 出于想要孩子的渴望，她决定偷走一个新生儿。

sentences.en: But nothing resulted from this line of inquiry.
sentences.zh: 但这一调查方向没有任何结果。

sentences.en: Newspapers published police sketches of the kidnapper, based on witness descriptions.
sentences.zh: 报纸根据目击者的描述刊登了绑匪的警方素描。

sentences.en: The one and only photograph that existed of Paul Fronzak was also shared.
sentences.zh: 保罗·弗龙恰克仅有的一张照片也被公布了出来。

sentences.en: It had been snapped shortly after his birth and showed Paul lying on a white sheet with his head turned to one side.
sentences.zh: 那是他出生后不久拍的，照片显示保罗躺在白色的床单上，头转向一边。

sentences.en: He was dressed in a nappy and a small white shirt with an ID bracelet on one wriSt.
sentences.zh: 他穿着尿布和一件白色小衬衫，手腕上戴着身份识别手环。

sentences.en: A handwritten card on his stomach detailed his name and weight.
sentences.zh: 他肚子上有一张手写的卡片，上面写着他的名字和体重。

sentences.en: It turned out that Paul also had an allergy that meant he couldn't have cow's milk, so newspapers published detailed recipes for a safe formula he could be fed.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，保罗还有过敏症，不能喝牛奶，所以报纸刊登了详细的配方奶制作方法，以便他能得到喂养。

sentences.en: Hundreds of tips flooded into the Chicago Police Department and a makeshift FBI office set up at Michael Reis Hospital.
sentences.zh: 数百条线索涌入芝加哥警察局和设在迈克尔·里斯医院的临时联邦调查局办公室。

sentences.en: Some of these were prank calls, but others seemed promising.
sentences.zh: 其中一些是恶作剧电话，但另一些看起来很有希望。

sentences.en: It was reported that three months earlier, a woman wearing a nurse's uniform had entered another Chicago hospital.
sentences.zh: 据报道，三个月前，一名穿着护士制服的女人进入了芝加哥的另一家医院。

sentences.en: She had started picking up babies from their nursery cribs and remarked that the facilities there were much cleaner than the ones at Michael Reis Hospital.
sentences.zh: 她开始把婴儿从育婴室的婴儿床里抱出来，并评论说那里的设施比迈克尔·里斯医院干净得多。

sentences.en: Soon, staffers realised the woman didn't work there and she was removed from the premises.
sentences.zh: 很快，工作人员意识到那个女人不是那里的员工，于是将她赶了出去。

sentences.en: Investigators tried to track this woman down, but she was never identified.
sentences.zh: 调查人员试图追踪这个女人，但她从未被查明身份。

sentences.en: One caller said they knew a woman who had formerly been a nurse in several maternity wards.
sentences.zh: 一名举报人说，他们认识一个曾经在多家产科病房当过护士的女人。

sentences.en: When her ex-husband was given custody of their children, she tried to burn down his house.
sentences.zh: 当她的前夫获得孩子们的监护权后，她曾试图烧毁他的房子。

sentences.en: Another call came in from someone who'd overheard their taxi driver taking credit for the crime.
sentences.zh: 另一个电话来自一个无意中听到自家出租车司机吹嘘自己犯下此案的人。

sentences.en: A telephone operator listening in on a call reported hearing something similar from someone else.
sentences.zh: 一名监听通话的电话接线员报告说，从别人那里听到了类似的消息。

sentences.en: But none of these leads went anywhere.
sentences.zh: 但这些线索最终都不了了之。

sentences.en: People reported women they knew who resembled the sketch of the kidnapper.
sentences.zh: 人们举报了他们认识的、长得像绑匪素描的女性。

sentences.en: Other women were reported after strangers saw them on public transport, seemingly trying to conceal infants they were carrying from view.
sentences.zh: 还有一些女性在被陌生人看到在公共交通工具上似乎试图遮挡怀中婴儿时被举报。

sentences.en: However, every woman who was reported had an alibi for the time of the kidnapping.
sentences.zh: 然而，每一位被举报的女性都有绑架案发时的不在场证明。

sentences.en: And the mothers seemingly hiding their children from sight were actually protecting them from Chicago's cold weather.
sentences.zh: 而那些看似在遮挡孩子的母亲，其实是在保护她们免受芝加哥寒冷天气的影响。

sentences.en: Every lead seemed to fizzle out and soon investigators stopped sharing as much information with the media, with an FBI spokesperson explaining,
sentences.zh: 每一条线索似乎都石沉大海，很快调查人员就不再向媒体透露太多信息，一位联邦调查局发言人解释道：

sentences.en: We defeat our own purpose if we let the kidnapper know what we're doing to find her.
sentences.zh: “如果我们让绑匪知道我们正在采取什么行动来抓她，那就适得其反了。”

sentences.en: Meanwhile, Dora and Chester Fronczak were trying their best to cope.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，多拉和切斯特·弗龙恰克正在尽力应对。

sentences.en: Dora remained in hospital but was moved from a shared suite to a single room for privacy.
sentences.zh: 多拉仍留在医院，但为了隐私，她从套房搬到了单人病房。

sentences.en: She kept baby Paul's photograph in a wooden frame by her bed.
sentences.zh: 她把保罗的婴儿照放在床边的木框里。

sentences.en: Doctors monitored Dora constantly and gave her sedatives at night to help her sleep.
sentences.zh: 医生不断监测多拉的情况，并在晚上给她服用镇静剂以帮助她入睡。

sentences.en: Her room was guarded by police at all times so that journalists and members of the public could be kept away.
sentences.zh: 她的病房时刻有警察把守，以阻挡记者和公众。

sentences.en: The only people permitted to see Dora were her husband, family members, investigators, and the hospital's Roman Catholic chaplain.
sentences.zh: 唯一获准探望多拉的人只有她的丈夫、家人、调查人员和医院的罗马天主教牧师。

sentences.en: As a staunch Catholic, Dora found hope in the news that masses and convents all over the country were praying for the safe return of her son.
sentences.zh: 作为一名虔诚的天主教徒，多拉从全国各地的弥撒和修道院都在为她儿子的平安归来祈祷的消息中找到了希望。

sentences.en: She received cards and letters from far-flung destinations like Russia and Brazil, from strangers who sympathised with her tragedy.
sentences.zh: 她收到了来自俄罗斯和巴西等遥远地区的卡片和信件，都是同情她遭遇的陌生人寄来的。

sentences.en: But not everyone was kind.
sentences.zh: 但并非每个人都那么善良。

sentences.en: At one point, a doctor from the hospital told Dora she should have known that the kidnapper wasn't a real nurse because she hadn't been wearing a cap.
sentences.zh: 有一次，医院的一名医生告诉多拉，她本该知道绑匪不是真正的护士，因为她没戴护士帽。

sentences.en: He scolded her for handing over her baby.
sentences.zh: 他责怪她把孩子交给了别人。

sentences.en: His words left Dora with feelings of guilt and bitterness.
sentences.zh: 他的话让多拉感到内疚和痛苦。

sentences.en: She had thought she was safe in a hospital and was angered by his suggestion that it was her responsibility to recognise a potential kidnapper.
sentences.zh: 她本以为在医院里是安全的，对于他暗示她有责任识别潜在的绑架者，她感到非常愤怒。

sentences.en: Dora drew strength from her husband Chester, who remained supportive and loving, never once blaming her for what had happened.
sentences.zh: 多拉从丈夫切斯特那里获得了力量，他始终给予她支持和爱，从未因发生的事情责怪过她一次。

sentences.en: Two days after Paul was kidnapped, his father Chester appeared at a press conference at the urging of police.
sentences.zh: 保罗被绑架两天后，他的父亲切斯特在警方的敦促下出席了新闻发布会。

sentences.en: He found it difficult to speak and fought back tears as he was asked if he had anything to say to the kidnapper.
sentences.zh: 当被问及是否有话对绑架者说时，他难以开口，强忍着泪水。

sentences.en: Quote,
sentences.zh: 他说：

sentences.en: The following day, Dora also managed to issue a public plea via the media.
sentences.zh: 第二天，多拉也设法通过媒体公开呼吁。

sentences.en: She appeared in a wheelchair in the hospital's lobby, her eyes red from crying, and stated,
sentences.zh: 她坐在医院大厅的轮椅上，哭得双眼通红，说道：

sentences.en: All I can say is that this woman must have been desperate for a baby to do such a horrible thing.
sentences.zh: 我只能说，这个女人一定是非常渴望有一个孩子，才会做出这种可怕的事情。

sentences.en: Take good care of him and see that he gets enough to eat.
sentences.zh: 请好好照顾他，确保他吃饱穿暖。

sentences.en: He is everything we built our hopes on for the future.
sentences.zh: 他是我们对未来寄予的所有希望。

sentences.en: Please, return the baby to us.
sentences.zh: 求求你，把孩子还给我们。

sentences.en: On Tuesday May 5, just over a week after her son's kidnapping, Dora Fronzac was discharged from the hospital.
sentences.zh: 5月5日星期二，在儿子被绑架一周多后，多拉·弗朗扎克出院了。

sentences.en: She and Chester were driven home in an unmarked police car.
sentences.zh: 她和切斯特乘坐一辆便衣警车回到了家。

sentences.en: The couple lived in an attic apartment of Chester's parents' home.
sentences.zh: 这对夫妇住在切斯特父母家的一间阁楼公寓里。

sentences.en: For weeks, Dora refused to leave the apartment except to attend mass once a day.
sentences.zh: 几周以来，多拉除了每天去参加弥撒外，拒绝离开公寓。

sentences.en: She didn't want to socialise with friends or participate in activities that had interested her prior to having Paul.
sentences.zh: 她不想和朋友社交，也不想参加那些在生下保罗之前她感兴趣的活动。

sentences.en: She wanted to be home when the phone finally rang with the news that Paul had been found.
sentences.zh: 她想待在家里，等待电话响起，传来保罗被找到的消息。

sentences.en: Two FBI agents set up recording equipment in the den of the house so they could tape every call that came through.
sentences.zh: 两名联邦调查局特工在房子的书房里安装了录音设备，以便记录下每一个打进来的电话。

sentences.en: For 24 hours a day, two agents remained in the Fronzac residence and took responsibility for monitoring the family's phone at all times.
sentences.zh: 两名特工全天24小时留在弗朗扎克家中，负责随时监控家里的电话。

sentences.en: They waited for someone to call with a ransom demand or some other information relating to the kidnapping.
sentences.zh: 他们等待着有人打来电话提出赎金要求，或提供与绑架案有关的其他信息。

sentences.en: But there was nothing.
sentences.zh: 但什么都没有。

sentences.en: After two weeks, one of the agents was taken off the job.
sentences.zh: 两周后，其中一名特工被调离了岗位。

sentences.en: The other remained for another week just in case anything came in.
sentences.zh: 另一名特工又留了一周，以防有任何消息传来。

sentences.en: But nothing did, and after three weeks, the FBI ended the detail altogether.
sentences.zh: 但依然一无所获，三周后，联邦调查局彻底结束了这项任务。

sentences.en: As time wore on, investigators occasionally received tip-offs from the public.
sentences.zh: 随着时间的推移，调查人员偶尔会收到公众提供的线索。

sentences.en: A woman who owned a restaurant a couple of hours west of Chicago noticed a couple come in one morning carrying a baby.
sentences.zh: 芝加哥以西几小时车程外的一家餐馆女老板，一天早上注意到一对夫妇带着一个婴儿走了进来。

sentences.en: They asked her if they could wash the baby and have some milk.
sentences.zh: 他们问她能不能给婴儿洗洗，再给点牛奶。

sentences.en: The restaurant owner said sure, then asked how old the infant was.
sentences.zh: 餐馆老板说没问题，然后问婴儿多大了。

sentences.en: Three weeks, I think, answered the woman.
sentences.zh: 那个女人回答说：我想大概三周大吧。

sentences.en: The restaurant owner quickly called the police to report the strange incident, but by the time they arrived at the scene, the couple had driven away with the infant in a Chevrolet.
sentences.zh: 餐馆老板迅速报警报告了这起奇怪的事件，但当警察赶到现场时，那对夫妇已经开着一辆雪佛兰带着婴儿离开了。

sentences.en: Although surveillance was set up around the restaurant's vicinity, the couple were never seen again.
sentences.zh: 尽管在餐馆附近设置了监视，但那对夫妇再也没有出现过。

sentences.en: An abandoned baby found in Georgia seemed like the breakthrough investigators were waiting for, but the child wasn't Paul.
sentences.zh: 在佐治亚州发现的一名被遗弃的婴儿似乎是调查人员一直在等待的突破口，但那个孩子并不是保罗。

sentences.en: One day, Dora Fronzack received a call demanding $10,000 in exchange for her baby.
sentences.zh: 一天，多拉·弗朗扎克接到一个电话，索要1万美元作为归还她孩子的交换条件。

sentences.en: She was to place the cash in a bag and leave it in the lobby of a particular Chicago building.
sentences.zh: 她被要求把现金装进袋子里，放在芝加哥某栋大楼的大厅里。

sentences.en: Dora notified the police, who arranged a sting operation with a female officer disguised as Dora.
sentences.zh: 多拉通知了警方，警方安排了一次诱捕行动，由一名女警官伪装成多拉。

sentences.en: The officer dropped off a bag filled with the newspaper clippings at the building.
sentences.zh: 那名警官在大楼里放下了一个装满剪报的袋子。

sentences.en: A young woman soon came to collect it.
sentences.zh: 一名年轻女子很快过来取走了袋子。

sentences.en: There was no sign of Paul.
sentences.zh: 但保罗的踪影全无。

sentences.en: Police arrested the woman and quickly discovered that she wasn't the kidnapper.
sentences.zh: 警方逮捕了那名女子，很快发现她并不是绑架者。

sentences.en: She'd just conceived of the ruse as an extortion plot.
sentences.zh: 她只是想出了这个诡计作为敲诈计划。

sentences.en: Weeks and months continued to pass.
sentences.zh: 几周、几个月过去了。

sentences.en: Paul Fronzack's first birthday came and went in April of 1965.
sentences.zh: 1965年4月，保罗·弗朗扎克的一周岁生日悄然过去。

sentences.en: By this point, the tip-off centre leads had almost stopped entirely.
sentences.zh: 到这时，线索中心的举报几乎完全停止了。

sentences.en: FBI agents working the investigation were reassigned and detectives moved on to focus on new cases.
sentences.zh: 负责调查的联邦调查局特工被重新分配，侦探们也转而专注于新的案件。

sentences.en: The kidnapping of Paul Fronzack had well and truly gone cold.
sentences.zh: 保罗·弗朗扎克的绑架案彻底成为了一桩悬案。

sentences.en: Casefile will be back shortly.
sentences.zh: Casefile节目稍后回来。

sentences.en: Thank you for supporting us by listening to this episode's sponsors.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的赞助商，以此支持我们。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening to this episode's ads.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的广告。

sentences.en: By supporting our sponsors, you support Casefile to continue to deliver quality content.
sentences.zh: 通过支持我们的赞助商，您就是在支持Casefile继续提供优质内容。

sentences.en: Friday, July 2, 1965 was a warm but slightly cloudy day in the city of Newark, New Jersey.
sentences.zh: 1965年7月2日，星期五，新泽西州纽瓦克市天气温暖，但略显阴沉。

sentences.en: The downtown strip of Broad Street was bustling as shoppers moved between the stores that dotted the popular destination.
sentences.zh: 宽街（Broad Street）的市中心地带熙熙攘攘，购物者在点缀着这个热门目的地的商店之间穿梭。

sentences.en: High-end department stores were what Broad Street was known for, leading to the area being dubbed Lady's Mile.
sentences.zh: 宽街以高端百货商店闻名，因此该地区被称为“女士大道”。

sentences.en: One such store was McCrory's, which sat in a four-storey building on the corner of Broad and Cedar Streets.
sentences.zh: 其中一家商店是麦克罗里百货（McCrory's），它坐落在宽街和雪松街拐角处的一栋四层建筑里。

sentences.en: On the second floor was an expensive restaurant that was almost as popular as the store itself.
sentences.zh: 二楼有一家昂贵的餐厅，几乎和商店本身一样受欢迎。

sentences.en: Buses and trains stopped nearby, making the area one of New Jersey's busiest thoroughfares.
sentences.zh: 公共汽车和火车都在附近停靠，使该地区成为新泽西州最繁忙的交通要道之一。

sentences.en: At about 3pm on that Friday, someone pushed a baby pram up to the entrance of McCrory's.
sentences.zh: 那个周五下午3点左右，有人推着一辆婴儿车来到麦克罗里百货的入口处。

sentences.en: Sitting inside the pram was a little boy who looked to be just over a year or so old.
sentences.zh: 车里坐着一个小男孩，看起来刚过一岁左右。

sentences.en: He was wearing a blue suit with a matching blue cap.
sentences.zh: 他穿着一套蓝色西装，戴着一顶配套的蓝色帽子。

sentences.en: The person pushing the boy's pram parked it near the front door of the department store, then turned and walked away, leaving the boy alone.
sentences.zh: 推着婴儿车的人把它停在百货商店的前门附近，然后转身走开了，把男孩独自留在了那里。

sentences.en: Shoppers and pedestrians continued to pass by the pram with the little boy inside, but didn't seem concerned by seeing a toddler left alone.
sentences.zh: 购物者和行人不断从婴儿车旁经过，车里坐着小男孩，但似乎并没有人因为看到一个幼儿被独自留下而感到担忧。

sentences.en: It was two hours before somebody called the police to report the abandoned child.
sentences.zh: 直到两个小时后，才有人打电话报警报告这个被遗弃的孩子。

sentences.en: Whoever placed the call refused to give their name.
sentences.zh: 打电话的人拒绝透露姓名。

sentences.en: Sometime after 5pm, officers arrived at the scene and found the pram with the boy inside, as described.
sentences.zh: 下午5点过后不久，警察赶到现场，发现了如描述中所说的那辆婴儿车和里面的男孩。

sentences.en: The child had a runny nose and a cold.
sentences.zh: 孩子流着鼻涕，感冒了。

sentences.en: He also had the remnants of a black eye.
sentences.zh: 他的眼眶还有黑青的痕迹。

sentences.en: The boy was taken to Newark Hospital for an assessment and a detective from the city's police department was assigned to the case.
sentences.zh: 男孩被送往纽瓦克医院进行评估，市警察局的一名侦探被指派负责此案。

sentences.en: The boy's age was estimated to be around 14 months old.
sentences.zh: 男孩的年龄估计在14个月左右。

sentences.en: He was 30 inches tall and weighed 20 pounds.
sentences.zh: 他身高30英寸，体重20磅。

sentences.en: Aside from the cold and the fading bruise by his left eye, he was in good health.
sentences.zh: 除了感冒和左眼旁正在消退的淤青外，他身体状况良好。

sentences.en: Detective Joseph Farrell was tasked with finding the boy's identity.
sentences.zh: 侦探约瑟夫·法雷尔（Joseph Farrell）负责查明男孩的身份。

sentences.en: As there were no surveillance cameras outside McCrory's department store, the detective had no footage of the moment the toddler was abandoned,
sentences.zh: 由于麦克罗里百货商店外没有监控摄像头，侦探没有幼儿被遗弃那一刻的录像，

sentences.en: nor had any witnesses come forward to report seeing it happen.
sentences.zh: 也没有目击者站出来报告看到这一幕。

sentences.en: He knew the rough time frame from when people had started noticing the boy, but there was zero information about who had left him there.
sentences.zh: 他知道人们开始注意到这个男孩的大致时间，但关于是谁把他留在那里的信息却为零。

sentences.en: Detective Farrell believed the child had most likely been abandoned by someone who had wanted him to be discovered and well cared for.
sentences.zh: 法雷尔侦探认为，这个孩子很可能是被一个希望他被发现并得到妥善照顾的人遗弃的。

sentences.en: He hadn't been taken to a remote area and left in a poor condition.
sentences.zh: 他没有被带到偏远地区并被置于恶劣的环境中。

sentences.en: Instead, the perpetrator had dressed him nicely and deliberately taken him to a busy intersection frequented by wealthy shoppers.
sentences.zh: 相反，肇事者把他打扮得很漂亮，并特意把他带到了一个富裕购物者经常出没的繁忙路口。

sentences.en: Presumably, they felt unable to care for him themselves, so they had tried to ensure his safety another way.
sentences.zh: 据推测，他们觉得无法亲自照顾他，所以试图用另一种方式确保他的安全。

sentences.en: Detective Farrell ran a series of ads about the abandoned toddler in New Jersey and New York newspapers.
sentences.zh: 法雷尔侦探在新泽西州和纽约州的报纸上刊登了一系列关于这名被遗弃幼儿的广告。

sentences.en: As well as containing details about his discovery, they asked anyone with information about the case to contact police.
sentences.zh: 除了包含关于他被发现的细节外，他们还要求任何有案件信息的人联系警方。

sentences.en: The ads ran for a few days, but only one call came through.
sentences.zh: 广告刊登了几天，但只接到了一个电话。

sentences.en: It turned out to be unrelated to the boy who'd been found.
sentences.zh: 结果发现与被发现的男孩无关。

sentences.en: Detective Farrell was having no luck figuring out where the toddler had come from.
sentences.zh: 法雷尔侦探在查明幼儿的来历方面毫无进展。

sentences.en: He suspected that whoever had abandoned him wasn't from Newark at all.
sentences.zh: 他怀疑遗弃他的人根本不是纽瓦克本地人。

sentences.en: Then, Detective Farrell remembered the case of Paul Fronczak, who had been kidnapped from a Chicago hospital 15 months earlier.
sentences.zh: 这时，法雷尔侦探想起了15个月前从芝加哥一家医院被绑架的保罗·弗朗扎克案。

sentences.en: The case had made national and international headlines, so even though the detective resided almost 800 miles away in a different part of the country, he remembered it well.
sentences.zh: 该案曾登上全国和国际头条，所以尽管这位侦探住在近800英里外该国的另一个地方，但他对此记忆犹新。

sentences.en: Detective Farrell found a photo of baby Paul Fronczak and compared it to one taken of the abandoned toddler.
sentences.zh: 法雷尔侦探找到了婴儿保罗·弗朗扎克的照片，并将其与被遗弃幼儿的照片进行了对比。

sentences.en: He also examined photos of Paul's parents, Dora and Chester Fronczak.
sentences.zh: 他还检查了保罗父母多拉和切斯特·弗朗扎克的照片。

sentences.en: The detective could see a resemblance.
sentences.zh: 侦探看出了一些相似之处。

sentences.en: The toddler also looked to be the same age that Paul would be by now.
sentences.zh: 这个幼儿看起来也和保罗现在的年龄一样大。

sentences.en: Detective Farrell sent a letter to Chicago's Chief of Detectives, officially requesting the Paul Fronczak case file.
sentences.zh: 法雷尔侦探给芝加哥侦探长写了一封信，正式索要保罗·弗朗扎克的案卷。

sentences.en: Investigators in Chicago were excited to receive the detective's letter.
sentences.zh: 芝加哥的调查人员收到侦探的信后感到非常兴奋。

sentences.en: In the 15 months since Paul Fronczak had vanished, they had submitted around 10,000 children to medical tests in an attempt to see if they could be baby Paul.
sentences.zh: 在保罗·弗朗扎克失踪后的15个月里，他们已经对大约1万名儿童进行了医学测试，试图看看他们是否可能是婴儿保罗。

sentences.en: All of them had been excluded.
sentences.zh: 所有这些孩子都被排除了。

sentences.en: Because DNA wasn't accessible at the time, investigators had no way of definitively comparing Paul Fronczak's genetics to any other child.
sentences.zh: 由于当时无法进行DNA检测，调查人员无法将保罗·弗朗扎克的基因与其他任何孩子进行明确的对比。

sentences.en: But they could test their blood to see if that provided any clues.
sentences.zh: 但他们可以检测他们的血液，看看是否能提供任何线索。

sentences.en: There were between 15 and 20 tests available that gave information about blood group factors, including blood type,
sentences.zh: 当时有15到20种检测方法可以提供关于血型因素的信息，包括血型，

sentences.en: and whether an individual had a presence or absence of protein on their red blood cells.
sentences.zh: 以及个人的红细胞上是否存在蛋白质。

sentences.en: By collecting all of these details, experts could make an educated guess as to whether one individual could be related to another.
sentences.zh: 通过收集所有这些细节，专家们可以对一个人是否可能与另一个人有亲缘关系做出有根据的推测。

sentences.en: Comparing hand and footprints was another method of identification, but Paul had been kidnapped before the hospital had taken his prints.
sentences.zh: 比较手印和脚印是另一种识别方法，但保罗在医院采集指纹之前就被绑架了。

sentences.en: However, they did have a photo of newborn Paul that provided a clear view of his left ear.
sentences.zh: 不过，他们确实有一张新生儿保罗的照片，可以清晰地看到他的左耳。

sentences.en: It was believed that by examining the ridges, slope, and shape of someone's ear, you could confirm their true identity.
sentences.zh: 人们认为，通过检查一个人的耳朵的纹路、坡度和形状，可以确认他们的真实身份。

sentences.en: After being found outside the department store, the abandoned toddler had been transferred to a private adoption home owned by a middle-aged couple and their daughter.
sentences.zh: 在百货商店外被发现后，这名被遗弃的幼儿被转移到了一家私人收养所，该收养所由一对中年夫妇和他们的女儿经营。

sentences.en: The couple had nicknamed him Scott.
sentences.zh: 这对夫妇给他起了个绰号叫“斯科特”（Scott）。

sentences.en: FBI agents arranged for Scott to have his blood taken and made a mould of his left ear.
sentences.zh: 联邦调查局特工安排斯科特进行了抽血，并制作了他的左耳模型。

sentences.en: Then they waited for experts to analyse this information.
sentences.zh: 然后他们等待专家分析这些信息。

sentences.en: By March 1966, eight months after Scott was found, the FBI had reached a conclusion.
sentences.zh: 到1966年3月，即斯科特被发现八个月后，联邦调查局得出了结论。

sentences.en: Scott was the only child out of 10,000 tested who could possibly be Paul Fronczak.
sentences.zh: 斯科特是1万名受试儿童中唯一可能是保罗·弗朗扎克的人。

sentences.en: Adding further weight to this finding was a letter from an official at the New Jersey Bureau of Children's Services, which expressed their absolute certainty that Scott was Paul.
sentences.zh: 新泽西州儿童服务局的一名官员写的一封信进一步证实了这一发现，信中表达了他们绝对肯定斯科特就是保罗。

sentences.en: Dora and Chester Fronczak had tried their best to move forward in the two years after their baby was kidnapped.
sentences.zh: 在孩子被绑架后的两年里，多拉和切斯特·弗朗扎克尽了最大努力继续生活。

sentences.en: Initially, Dora had kept a close eye on the time passing, hoping that the perpetrator would make contact on a meaningful date.
sentences.zh: 起初，多拉密切关注着时间的流逝，希望肇事者会在某个有意义的日子联系他们。

sentences.en: Mother's Day was two weeks after Paul's kidnapping.
sentences.zh: 母亲节是在保罗被绑架两周后。

sentences.en: Then a week after that was her and Chester's wedding anniversary.
sentences.zh: 再过一周就是她和切斯特的结婚纪念日。

sentences.en: But these days came and went with no news of Paul.
sentences.zh: 但这些日子一天天过去，依然没有保罗的消息。

sentences.en: Eventually, Dora lost track of time altogether.
sentences.zh: 最终，多拉完全失去了对时间的感知。

sentences.en: In March 1966, one month before Paul's second birthday, Dora and Chester filed a lawsuit against Michael Rees Hospital.
sentences.zh: 1966年3月，在保罗两岁生日前一个月，多拉和切斯特对迈克尔·里斯医院提起了诉讼。

sentences.en: They were accusing the hospital of negligence in allowing an unauthorised person in the maternity ward.
sentences.zh: 他们指控医院疏忽大意，允许未经授权的人员进入产科病房。

sentences.en: The couple were seeking $1 million for grief, pain, mental anguish and anxiety.
sentences.zh: 这对夫妇要求赔偿100万美元，以补偿他们的悲伤、痛苦、精神折磨和焦虑。

sentences.en: Just three weeks after the suit was filed, the Fronczaks received a letter from the FBI.
sentences.zh: 诉讼提起仅三周后，弗朗扎克夫妇就收到了联邦调查局的一封信。

sentences.en: It informed them that an unknown male child had been found in Newark, New Jersey.
sentences.zh: 信中通知他们，在新泽西州纽瓦克发现了一名身份不明的男童。

sentences.en: Blood testing had indicated it was possible he was their kidnapped son.
sentences.zh: 血液检测表明，他有可能是他们被绑架的儿子。

sentences.en: The FBI asked the Fronczaks to travel to New Jersey to identify their child for themselves.
sentences.zh: 联邦调查局要求弗朗扎克夫妇前往新泽西州，亲自辨认他们的孩子。

sentences.en: The Fronczaks made the 800-mile road trip east to New Jersey.
sentences.zh: 弗朗扎克夫妇驱车向东行驶了800英里，前往新泽西州。

sentences.en: Arrangements had been made for them to meet Scott at the office of the state's adoption bureau.
sentences.zh: 他们已安排在州收养局的办公室与斯科特见面。

sentences.en: The couple were rushed into an empty room and waited with a caseworker.
sentences.zh: 这对夫妇被匆忙带进一个空房间，与一名个案工作者一起等待。

sentences.en: Then the door opened and another caseworker walked in with Scott, who was dressed in a white jumper suit with matching socks and shoes.
sentences.zh: 接着门开了，另一名个案工作者带着斯科特走了进来，他穿着一件白色连体衣，配着配套的袜子和鞋子。

sentences.en: Almost immediately, Dora cried out,
sentences.zh: 多拉几乎立刻哭喊道：

sentences.en: My God, that is my baby.
sentences.zh: 天哪，那是我的孩子。

sentences.en: Although the Fronczaks recognised Paul as their son, they still had to legally adopt him, as there was no way to prove he was biologically theirs.
sentences.zh: 尽管弗朗扎克夫妇认出保罗是他们的儿子，但他们仍然必须在法律上收养他，因为没有办法证明他在生物学上是他们的孩子。

sentences.en: They had already been pre-approved and the initial process only took a few days.
sentences.zh: 他们之前已经通过了预审，初步程序只用了几天时间。

sentences.en: Then the reunited family made the journey back home to Chicago, where a large crowd of journalists were waiting for them.
sentences.zh: 随后，这个团聚的家庭踏上了回芝加哥的旅程，一大群记者在那里等着他们。

sentences.en: Chester and Dora were tight-lipped and gave little away as they carried Paul into their house.
sentences.zh: 切斯特和多拉守口如瓶，在把保罗带进屋时几乎没有透露任何信息。

sentences.en: The next day, they had Paul baptised at their Catholic church and the trio began settling into life together.
sentences.zh: 第二天，他们在天主教堂为保罗举行了洗礼，三人开始共同生活。

sentences.en: The fact that Paul had been returned to them after more than two years seemed to the Fronczaks like a miracle.
sentences.zh: 保罗在两年多后回到他们身边，对弗朗扎克夫妇来说就像是一个奇迹。

sentences.en: By the end of the year, the family of three was joined by one more.
sentences.zh: 到年底，这个三口之家又增加了一名成员。

sentences.en: After 15 months without Paul, Dora and Chester had made the difficult decision to try for another baby.
sentences.zh: 在失去保罗15个月后，多拉和切斯特做出了一个艰难的决定，尝试再要一个孩子。

sentences.en: When they received word that Paul had been found in New Jersey, Dora had just become pregnant.
sentences.zh: 当他们收到保罗在新泽西州被找到的消息时，多拉刚刚怀孕。

sentences.en: In December 1966, Dora gave birth to another healthy baby boy who was named David.
sentences.zh: 1966年12月，多拉生下了另一个健康的男婴，取名为大卫。

sentences.en: The Fronczaks were finally able to move forward as a family.
sentences.zh: 弗朗扎克一家终于能够作为一个家庭继续前行了。

sentences.en: Eight years later, in December 1974, the Fronczak family were preparing to celebrate Christmas.
sentences.zh: 八年后的1974年12月，弗朗扎克一家正在准备庆祝圣诞节。

sentences.en: One day, when Chester was at work and Dora was busy with something, the now ten-year-old Paul Fronczak decided to snoop around the family's house looking for Christmas presents.
sentences.zh: 一天，当切斯特在上班，多拉正忙着别的事情时，现在十岁的保罗·弗朗扎克决定在家里四处翻找圣诞礼物。

sentences.en: Knowing his parents would hide any gifts they bought for him and his brother,
sentences.zh: 因为知道父母会把给他和弟弟买的任何礼物藏起来，

sentences.en: Paul thought the basement's crawlspace would be a good spot to check.
sentences.zh: 保罗认为地下室的爬行空间会是一个很好的搜寻地点。

sentences.en: He crept downstairs and moved an old sofa that sat in front of the door to the crawlspace.
sentences.zh: 他悄悄下楼，移开了挡在爬行空间门前的一张旧沙发。

sentences.en: Then he opened the three-by-four-foot wooden door and squeezed inside.
sentences.zh: 然后他打开了那扇三乘四英尺的木门，挤了进去。

sentences.en: The crawlspace was full of old clothes, books and holiday decorations.
sentences.zh: 爬行空间里堆满了旧衣服、书籍和节日装饰品。

sentences.en: Exploring the area on his hands and knees, Paul looked for anything that looked like a possible gift.
sentences.zh: 保罗手脚并用地探索着这个区域，寻找任何看起来像礼物的东西。

sentences.en: In one corner behind some framed paintings were several shoeboxes and a hat box.
sentences.zh: 在一些装裱好的画作后面的一个角落里，有几个鞋盒和一个帽子盒。

sentences.en: Paul opened them.
sentences.zh: 保罗打开了它们。

sentences.en: All four boxes were filled with old newspaper clippings and letters.
sentences.zh: 这四个盒子里装满了旧剪报和信件。

sentences.en: Headlines for the articles described the search for a stolen baby.
sentences.zh: 文章标题描述了对一名被拐婴儿的搜寻过程。

sentences.en: One article featured a photograph of Paul's parents.
sentences.zh: 其中一篇文章刊登了保罗父母的照片。

sentences.en: As Paul started to read the articles, he realised that they were all about him.
sentences.zh: 当保罗开始阅读这些文章时，他意识到它们写的全是关于他自己的事。

sentences.en: He had never been told of his kidnapping, so the news was shocking and distressing.
sentences.zh: 他从未被告知自己曾被绑架过，所以这个消息让他感到震惊和痛苦。

sentences.en: Other articles detailed how he had been found more than a year later and eventually reunited with his parents.
sentences.zh: 其他文章详细讲述了他一年多后是如何被找到，并最终与父母团聚的。

sentences.en: The letters were mostly from strangers sympathising with the family after Paul's kidnapping.
sentences.zh: 这些信件大多来自陌生人，他们在保罗被绑架后对这家人表示同情。

sentences.en: Later that day, Paul took a handful of the news clippings and showed them to his mother, asking if they were really about him.
sentences.zh: 那天晚些时候，保罗拿了一把剪报给母亲看，问她这些是不是真的关于他。

sentences.en: Dora told Paul off for snooping, before admitting,
sentences.zh: 多拉先是责备保罗偷看，随后承认道：

sentences.en: Yes, those are about you.
sentences.zh: 是的，那些都是关于你的。

sentences.en: You were kidnapped, we found you, we love you, and that is all there is to know.
sentences.zh: 你曾被绑架，我们找到了你，我们爱你，这就是你需要知道的一切。

sentences.en: Paul tried to forget the clippings.
sentences.zh: 保罗试图忘记这些剪报。

sentences.en: It was clear that his parents found the kidnapping too painful to discuss.
sentences.zh: 很明显，他的父母觉得绑架这件事太痛苦，不愿提起。

sentences.en: Over the years, Paul grew up, relocated to the city of Las Vegas, pursued different careers, and married, then divorced.
sentences.zh: 多年来，保罗长大了，搬到了拉斯维加斯，从事过不同的职业，结过婚，后来又离了婚。

sentences.en: When he was in his 40s, he began a relationship with a woman named Michelle.
sentences.zh: 四十多岁时，他开始与一位名叫米歇尔的女性交往。

sentences.en: The two got engaged and Michelle became pregnant with a baby girl.
sentences.zh: 两人订了婚，米歇尔怀上了一个女婴。

sentences.en: Paul Fronzak was excited to become a father.
sentences.zh: 保罗·弗朗扎克对即将为人父感到非常兴奋。

sentences.en: During one of Michelle's regular check-ups, her obstetrician asked Paul about his family's medical history.
sentences.zh: 在米歇尔的一次例行产检中，她的产科医生询问了保罗家族的病史。

sentences.en: The question caused Paul to confront some suspicions he'd long since buried.
sentences.zh: 这个问题促使保罗去面对他内心深处早已埋藏的怀疑。

sentences.en: Ever since Paul was a small child, he'd felt like he didn't quite belong.
sentences.zh: 从保罗小时候起，他就觉得自己与这个家格格不入。

sentences.en: After he'd learnt of his kidnapping, Paul began to doubt whether he was related to the Fronzaks at all.
sentences.zh: 在得知自己曾被绑架后，保罗开始怀疑自己是否真的与弗朗扎克一家有血缘关系。

sentences.en: He had always felt different to his parents and brother.
sentences.zh: 他一直觉得自己与父母和兄弟不同。

sentences.en: He looked very different to them.
sentences.zh: 他的长相与他们大相径庭。

sentences.en: Paul had sandy hair and a face with an angular bone structure with a strong jaw.
sentences.zh: 保罗有着沙色的头发，脸部骨骼轮廓分明，下巴强健。

sentences.en: His father and brother David shared the same roundish face with slightly droopy eyes.
sentences.zh: 他的父亲和兄弟大卫都有着同样的圆脸，眼睛略微下垂。

sentences.en: David also had the same dark hair as Chester and Dora.
sentences.zh: 大卫也和切斯特与多拉一样，有着深色的头发。

sentences.en: Paul felt isolated in terms of his likes and interests as well.
sentences.zh: 保罗在喜好和兴趣方面也感到孤立。

sentences.en: He was obsessed with music, which was a passion no one else in his family shared.
sentences.zh: 他痴迷于音乐，而这是他家里其他人都没有的爱好。

sentences.en: Paul was free-spirited and slightly rebellious, where David was more serious and conservative, like their strict Catholic parents.
sentences.zh: 保罗崇尚自由，略带叛逆，而大卫则像他们严厉的天主教父母一样，更加严肃和保守。

sentences.en: Discovering the newspaper clippings in the crawlspace had finally provided some kind of explanation for Paul's feeling of disconnection.
sentences.zh: 在爬行空间发现这些剪报，终于为保罗那种疏离感提供了一种解释。

sentences.en: But when his mother had insisted that he was their son, Paul knew it would be futile to question the matter further.
sentences.zh: 但当母亲坚称他是他们的儿子时，保罗知道再追问下去也是徒劳。

sentences.en: Plus, it didn't seem like there was any way to know for sure whether he was really Paul Fronzak or not.
sentences.zh: 况且，似乎也没有办法确定他到底是不是真正的保罗·弗朗扎克。

sentences.en: Over the decades that followed, awareness around DNA and genetics began to spread, and DNA testing became increasingly accessible and affordable.
sentences.zh: 在随后的几十年里，关于DNA和遗传学的认知开始普及，DNA检测也变得越来越容易获取且负担得起。

sentences.en: All of a sudden, it seemed that Paul had an easy way to find out the truth of his identity.
sentences.zh: 突然之间，保罗似乎有了一个简单的方法来查明自己的真实身份。

sentences.en: And now that he was preparing to become a father, he felt he had an obligation to discover the truth.
sentences.zh: 现在他即将成为一名父亲，他觉得有义务去发现真相。

sentences.en: Not just for himself, but for his baby.
sentences.zh: 不仅是为了他自己，也是为了他的孩子。

sentences.en: In 2012, shortly after the birth of Paul's daughter, his parents came to visit.
sentences.zh: 2012年，在保罗的女儿出生后不久，他的父母前来探望。

sentences.en: Paul asked if they would be willing to give him a sample of their DNA so they could find out once and for all if he really was Paul Fronzak.
sentences.zh: 保罗问他们是否愿意提供DNA样本，以便彻底查清他到底是不是保罗·弗朗扎克。

sentences.en: Although they hadn't discussed Paul's kidnapping with him in more than 30 years, Dora and Chester agreed.
sentences.zh: 尽管他们已经三十多年没和保罗讨论过绑架的事了，但多拉和切斯特还是同意了。

sentences.en: Paul pulled out some paternity test kits he'd purchased from a pharmacy.
sentences.zh: 保罗拿出了他从药店买来的亲子鉴定试剂盒。

sentences.en: Dora and Chester both swabbed their mouths and Paul organised the test kits for analysis.
sentences.zh: 多拉和切斯特都采集了口腔拭子，保罗将试剂盒整理好送去分析。

sentences.en: Not long after leaving Las Vegas, Dora called Paul to say they had changed their minds, telling him,
sentences.zh: 离开拉斯维加斯后不久，多拉打电话给保罗说他们改变主意了，告诉他：

sentences.en: But after debating the matter privately for a couple of weeks, Paul posted the kits to the testing company's lab.
sentences.zh: 但在私下讨论了几周后，保罗还是把试剂盒寄给了检测公司的实验室。

sentences.en: A couple of weeks later, he received a call from a company representative.
sentences.zh: 几周后，他接到了公司代表的电话。

sentences.en: We have the test results, the representative said.
sentences.zh: “检测结果出来了，”代表说。

sentences.en: There is no remote possibility that you are the son of Dora and Chester Fronzak.
sentences.zh: “你绝对不可能是多拉和切斯特·弗朗扎克的儿子。”

sentences.en: In 1966, Dora Fronzak had immediately recognised Paul as her missing son upon meeting him.
sentences.zh: 1966年，多拉·弗朗扎克在见到保罗时，立刻认出他就是自己失踪的儿子。

sentences.en: But others had always had doubts.
sentences.zh: 但其他人一直心存疑虑。

sentences.en: Staffers from New Jersey's Bureau of Children's Services had compared Paul's appearance to photographs of the Fronzaks.
sentences.zh: 新泽西州儿童服务局的工作人员曾将保罗的长相与弗朗扎克夫妇的照片进行了对比。

sentences.en: At least one believed that Paul resembled Dora from the front and had the same profile as Chester.
sentences.zh: 至少有一人认为保罗正面看像多拉，侧脸轮廓则像切斯特。

sentences.en: This led to the agency informing the FBI that they were certain Paul was the missing child.
sentences.zh: 这导致该机构通知联邦调查局，他们确信保罗就是那个失踪的孩子。

sentences.en: However, others noticed that Paul actually bore little similarity to the couple or the picture of newborn Paul.
sentences.zh: 然而，其他人注意到保罗实际上与这对夫妇或新生儿保罗的照片几乎没有相似之处。

sentences.en: His hair was sandy coloured instead of dark, his face had a rectangular shape, while theirs was rounder.
sentences.zh: 他的头发是沙色的，而不是深色；他的脸型是长方形的，而他们的是圆脸。

sentences.en: The blood tests hadn't excluded Paul as being related to the Fronzaks, but nothing about them had confirmed it either.
sentences.zh: 血液检测虽然没有排除保罗与弗朗扎克一家的血缘关系，但也并没有证实这一点。

sentences.en: Investigators had decided to have the Fronzaks meet the child, just in case.
sentences.zh: 调查人员决定让弗朗扎克夫妇见见这个孩子，以防万一。

sentences.en: In private, they admitted that the child wasn't the real Paul Fronzak.
sentences.zh: 私下里，他们承认这个孩子并不是真正的保罗·弗朗扎克。

sentences.en: A lieutenant from the Chicago Police Department who'd worked on the original kidnapping case told his family he was certain the Fronzaks had the wrong child.
sentences.zh: 一位曾参与最初绑架案调查的芝加哥警察局中尉告诉他的家人，他确信弗朗扎克夫妇认错了孩子。

sentences.en: The special agent in charge of the FBI's Chicago Bureau agreed with him.
sentences.zh: 负责联邦调查局芝加哥分局的特工也同意他的看法。

sentences.en: But they felt sorry for what the Fronzaks had gone through and knew they would provide the boy with a good home.
sentences.zh: 但他们同情弗朗扎克夫妇的遭遇，并知道他们会给这个男孩一个温暖的家。

sentences.en: Although Dora Fronzak had seemingly recognised Paul right away, she would admit decades later that she'd always had doubts.
sentences.zh: 尽管多拉·弗朗扎克似乎一眼就认出了保罗，但几十年后她承认自己一直心存疑虑。

sentences.en: But she desperately wanted Paul to be her missing son.
sentences.zh: 但她太渴望保罗就是她失踪的儿子了。

sentences.en: Regardless of whether the abandoned boy was related to her or not, it was clear that he needed parents.
sentences.zh: 无论这个被遗弃的男孩是否与她有血缘关系，很明显他需要父母。

sentences.en: Dora felt that she and Chester could save him.
sentences.zh: 多拉觉得她和切斯特可以拯救他。

sentences.en: She also worried that if they didn't claim him as theirs, they might be judged for rejecting him.
sentences.zh: 她也担心如果他们不认领他，可能会因为拒绝他而受到指责。

sentences.en: After a DNA test definitively proved that Paul Fronzak wasn't Dora and Chester's son, he was left with several mysteries.
sentences.zh: 在DNA检测最终证明保罗·弗朗扎克不是多拉和切斯特的儿子后，他留下了几个未解之谜。

sentences.en: Who was he?
sentences.zh: 他是谁？

sentences.en: And how had he come to be abandoned?
sentences.zh: 他是怎么被遗弃的？

sentences.en: And where was the real Paul Fronzak?
sentences.zh: 真正的保罗·弗朗扎克在哪里？

sentences.en: Paul decided to go public with his story, believing it was the best chance he had of answering these questions.
sentences.zh: 保罗决定公开他的故事，相信这是他回答这些问题的最好机会。

sentences.en: He reached out to George Knapp, an award-winning television journalist based in Las Vegas.
sentences.zh: 他联系了常驻拉斯维加斯的获奖电视记者乔治·纳普。

sentences.en: George agreed to cover the story and in April 2013 his report aired on the local news.
sentences.zh: 乔治同意报道这个故事，2013年4月，他的报道在当地新闻中播出。

sentences.en: Paul Fronzak was inundated with interview requests and messages from viewers all over the country.
sentences.zh: 保罗·弗朗扎克收到了来自全国各地观众的采访请求和信息，应接不暇。

sentences.en: One message was from an FBI special agent who said the FBI would reopen the case.
sentences.zh: 其中一条信息来自一位联邦调查局特工，他说联邦调查局将重新开启此案。

sentences.en: Another was from renowned genetic genealogist C.C.
sentences.zh: 另一条来自著名的遗传系谱学家C.C.

sentences.en: Moore, who offered to help Paul trace his true identity.
sentences.zh: 摩尔，她主动提出帮助保罗追寻他的真实身份。

sentences.en: Working with a team of three other researchers, C.C.
sentences.zh: 与另外三名研究人员组成的团队合作，C.C.

sentences.en: Moore began trying to trace Paul's heritage by uploading his DNA to several online databases.
sentences.zh: 摩尔开始通过将保罗的DNA上传到几个在线数据库来追溯他的血统。

sentences.en: Such databases were typically used by people interested in tracking their family trees and finding out more about their ancestry.
sentences.zh: 这些数据库通常被那些对追踪家谱和了解祖先感兴趣的人使用。

sentences.en: C.C.
sentences.zh: C.C.

sentences.en: and her team were able to slowly chip away at the project by identifying Paul's genetic relatives who had uploaded their DNA online.
sentences.zh: 和她的团队通过识别那些将DNA上传到网上的保罗的遗传亲属，慢慢地推进了这个项目。

sentences.en: C.C.
sentences.zh: C.C.

sentences.en: Moore asked Paul's genetic DNA.
sentences.zh: 摩尔询问了保罗的遗传DNA。

sentences.en: Initially, they only found distant cousins.
sentences.zh: 起初，他们只找到了远房表亲。

sentences.en: They worked on the project for more than a year.
sentences.zh: 他们在这个项目上工作了一年多。

sentences.en: Then, one afternoon, C.C.
sentences.zh: 然后，一天下午，C.C.

sentences.en: contacted Paul and asked him,
sentences.zh: 联系了保罗并问他：

sentences.en: What do you think of the name Jack?
sentences.zh: “你觉得‘杰克’这个名字怎么样？”

sentences.en: Paul said he liked it.
sentences.zh: 保罗说他喜欢这个名字。

sentences.en: Then C.C.
sentences.zh: 然后C.C.

sentences.en: told him,
sentences.zh: 告诉他：

sentences.en: Well, that is your name.
sentences.zh: “嗯，那就是你的名字。”

sentences.en: There's something else.
sentences.zh: “还有一件事。”

sentences.en: You have a twin sister And her name is Jill
sentences.zh: “你有一个双胞胎妹妹，她的名字叫吉尔。”

sentences.en: Casefile will be back shortly
sentences.zh: 案件档案节目稍后回来。

sentences.en: Thank you for supporting us by listening to this episode's sponsors
sentences.zh: 感谢您通过收听本期节目的赞助商来支持我们。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening to this episode's ads
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的广告。

sentences.en: By supporting our sponsors, you support Casefile to continue to deliver quality content
sentences.zh: 通过支持我们的赞助商，您支持了案件档案节目继续提供高质量的内容。

sentences.en: Located in South Jersey on Absecon Island, Atlantic City is New Jersey's most famous resort town
sentences.zh: 大西洋城位于南泽西的阿布西肯岛上，是新泽西州最著名的度假胜地。

sentences.en: Best known for its casinos, beaches and iconic boardwalk
sentences.zh: 这里以赌场、海滩和标志性的木板路而闻名。

sentences.en: The city also has an infamous reputation thanks to its history of organised crime
sentences.zh: 由于其有组织犯罪的历史，这座城市也臭名昭著。

sentences.en: In the early 1960s, married couple Gilbert and Marie Rosenthal lived in Atlantic City with their two young daughters, Linda and Karen
sentences.zh: 20世纪60年代初，已婚夫妇吉尔伯特和玛丽·罗森塔尔带着两个年幼的女儿琳达和凯伦住在大西洋城。

sentences.en: On Sunday October 27, 1963, the couple had two more children
sentences.zh: 1963年10月27日星期日，这对夫妇又添了两个孩子。

sentences.en: Marie Rosenthal gave birth to a set of twins, a boy and a girl they named Jack and Jill
sentences.zh: 玛丽·罗森塔尔生下了一对双胞胎，一个男孩和一个女孩，他们取名为杰克和吉尔。

sentences.en: A brief snippet about the births ran in a local newspaper, as October 27 was also the birthday of the Rosenthal's eldest child
sentences.zh: 当地一家报纸刊登了一则关于分娩的简短片段，因为10月27日也是罗森塔尔家大孩子的生日。

sentences.en: The twins had been born at a difficult time for the Rosenthal's
sentences.zh: 这对双胞胎出生时，罗森塔尔一家正处于困难时期。

sentences.en: Gilbert had served in the Korean War about ten years earlier and suffered a bad injury He had returned to the United States with severe back pain and post-traumatic stress disorder
sentences.zh: 吉尔伯特在大约十年前参加过朝鲜战争并受了重伤。他带着严重的背痛和创伤后应激障碍回到了美国。

sentences.en: Marie struggled with raising so many young children and turned to alcohol as a coping mechanism
sentences.zh: 玛丽在抚养这么多幼小的孩子时感到力不从心，便转向酒精作为应对机制。

sentences.en: Over time, she neglected to pay the household bills
sentences.zh: 随着时间的推移，她疏于支付家庭账单。

sentences.en: By November 1964, Marie was eight months pregnant with the couple's fifth child, Fred
sentences.zh: 到1964年11月，玛丽怀上了这对夫妇的第五个孩子弗雷德，已经八个月了。

sentences.en: At around the same time, they lost their home due to missed mortgage repayments
sentences.zh: 大约在同一时间，他们因错过抵押贷款还款而失去了房子。

sentences.en: The family had to move in with Gilbert's mother before later finding a home in a public housing development
sentences.zh: 一家人不得不搬去和吉尔伯特的母亲住在一起，后来又在公共住房开发区找到了一个住处。

sentences.en: This series of events led to Gilbert walking out on his family for six months, returning by the summer of 1965
sentences.zh: 这一系列事件导致吉尔伯特离家出走六个月，直到1965年夏天才回来。

sentences.en: Barbara Rosenthal was Marie's sister-in-law as she was married to Gilbert's brother
sentences.zh: 芭芭拉·罗森塔尔是玛丽的嫂子，因为她嫁给了吉尔伯特的兄弟。

sentences.en: Once a year, she and her husband Leonard would travel to visit Gilbert and Marie
sentences.zh: 她和丈夫伦纳德每年都会去探望吉尔伯特和玛丽一次。

sentences.en: During some of these visits, Barbara noticed that Jack and Jill were covered with small marks that looked like cigarette burns
sentences.zh: 在其中几次探访中，芭芭拉注意到杰克和吉尔身上布满了看起来像烟头烫伤的小痕迹。

sentences.en: Worried that the infants might be victims of abuse, Barbara spoke to her doctor about it
sentences.zh: 担心婴儿可能遭受虐待，芭芭拉向她的医生咨询了这件事。

sentences.en: He told her to mind her own business
sentences.zh: 他让她少管闲事。

sentences.en: Quote
sentences.zh: 引用。

sentences.en: Barbara's daughter Melanie was five or six years old at the time On the rare occasions that she met her young cousins, she noticed that they were always screaming
sentences.zh: 芭芭拉的女儿梅兰妮当时五六岁。在为数不多的几次见到年幼表亲的机会中，她注意到他们总是在尖叫。

sentences.en: Their mother Marie also complained about this, telling her relatives that the infants cried constantly
sentences.zh: 他们的母亲玛丽也抱怨过这一点，告诉亲戚们婴儿一直在哭。

sentences.en: When Melanie spoke to her parents about the twins, they told her that the Rosenthal's believed
sentences.zh: 当梅兰妮向父母提起这对双胞胎时，他们告诉她罗森塔尔夫妇认为……

sentences.en: On one visit to the Rosenthal's home, Melanie entered to hear the twins wailing
sentences.zh: 有一次去罗森塔尔家，梅兰妮进门就听到双胞胎在嚎哭。

sentences.en: Unable to see them, she went looking for them around the house
sentences.zh: 看不见他们，她便在屋子里四处寻找。

sentences.en: At the back was a bedroom with a closed door
sentences.zh: 后面有一个关着门的卧室。

sentences.en: Melanie pushed the door open
sentences.zh: 梅兰妮推开了门。

sentences.en: Inside, it was dark
sentences.zh: 里面很黑。

sentences.en: Melanie could see a wooden, crate-like structure that looked like a cage
sentences.zh: 梅兰妮看到一个木制的、像板条箱一样的结构，看起来像个笼子。

sentences.en: Both twins were restrained inside, bawling
sentences.zh: 两个双胞胎都被关在里面，大声哭闹。

sentences.en: Susan Warlett was 14 years old in the late summer of 1965
sentences.zh: 1965年夏末，苏珊·沃莱特14岁。

sentences.en: She worked regularly as a babysitter in an Atlantic City public housing development known as Pitney Village
sentences.zh: 她经常在大西洋城一个叫皮特尼村的公共住房区做保姆。

sentences.en: One day, an elegant, well-dressed woman approached her
sentences.zh: 一天，一位优雅、衣着考究的女士走近她。

sentences.en: Susan recognised the woman as Marie Rosenthal
sentences.zh: 苏珊认出那位女士是玛丽·罗森塔尔。

sentences.en: Who lived in a house nearby with her husband and two daughters
sentences.zh: 她和丈夫及两个女儿住在附近的一所房子里。

sentences.en: By this time, the family had left the house they'd lost due to missed mortgage payments And moved in to one of Pitney Village's public housing properties
sentences.zh: 当时，这家人已经离开了因错过抵押贷款而失去的房子，搬进了皮特尼村的一处公共住房。

sentences.en: Susan had seen how Marie doted on her girls
sentences.zh: 苏珊曾看到玛丽是多么宠爱她的女儿们。

sentences.en: Marie asked Susan if she could watch her children that night As she and her husband were going out for a special occasion And wouldn't be home until the next morning
sentences.zh: 玛丽问苏珊那天晚上能不能帮她照看孩子，因为她和丈夫要出去参加一个特殊场合，直到第二天早上才回来。

sentences.en: Susan agreed and headed to the family's two-storey brick row house that evening
sentences.zh: 苏珊答应了，那天晚上前往这家人住的两层砖砌联排别墅。

sentences.en: Inside, the home was small but clean and tidy
sentences.zh: 屋子里很小，但干净整洁。

sentences.en: Marie and Gilbert Rosenthal were dressed up in their finest clothes While four- and three-year-olds Linda and Karen were also well-dressed
sentences.zh: 玛丽和吉尔伯特·罗森塔尔穿着他们最好的衣服，四岁和三岁的琳达和凯伦也打扮得很漂亮。

sentences.en: Marie gave Susan some details about her daughter's care
sentences.zh: 玛丽给了苏珊一些关于照顾女儿的细节。

sentences.en: Before adding in an offhand way
sentences.zh: 然后随口补充道：

sentences.en: Oh, and the twins are upstairs But you don't have to bother with them
sentences.zh: “哦，双胞胎在楼上，但你不用管他们。”

sentences.en: Just leave them alone upstairs
sentences.zh: “让他们自己在楼上待着就行。”

sentences.en: The couple left and Susan was left shocked
sentences.zh: 这对夫妇离开了，苏珊感到震惊。

sentences.en: She'd had no idea there were more children
sentences.zh: 她根本不知道还有别的孩子。

sentences.en: Not feeling capable of caring for them all on her own She called her sister and asked her to come over and help
sentences.zh: 觉得自己无法独自照顾他们所有人，她打电话给姐姐，请她过来帮忙。

sentences.en: While Susan's sister minded the two older girls
sentences.zh: 当苏珊的姐姐照看两个大一点的女孩时，

sentences.en: Susan went upstairs to check on the twins
sentences.zh: 苏珊上楼去查看双胞胎的情况。

sentences.en: The second story was completely silent
sentences.zh: 二楼一片寂静。

sentences.en: After looking around the hallway at the different rooms
sentences.zh: 在走廊里看了看不同的房间后。

sentences.en: Susan noticed two closed doors to the left
sentences.zh: 苏珊注意到左边有两扇关着的门

sentences.en: Opening the first one, she saw a dark room
sentences.zh: 打开第一扇门，她看到一个昏暗的房间

sentences.en: Dimly lit by a window that allowed in some of the dusk light
sentences.zh: 窗户透进的一点暮光让房间显得有些昏暗

sentences.en: Next to the window was a crib with two toddlers inside
sentences.zh: 窗边有一张婴儿床，里面躺着两个蹒跚学步的孩子

sentences.en: The girl, Jill Rosenthal, stood and watched Susan silently
sentences.zh: 女孩吉尔·罗森塔尔站在那里，默默地看着苏珊

sentences.en: Her brother Jack cowered in a corner of the crib and whimpered
sentences.zh: 她的弟弟杰克蜷缩在婴儿床的角落里，发出呜咽声

sentences.en: Both were wearing pyjamas and their nappies were soiled
sentences.zh: 两人都穿着睡衣，尿布也脏了

sentences.en: Moving closer, Susan saw that the crib's sheets were filthy and Jack had a black eye
sentences.zh: 走近一看，苏珊发现婴儿床的床单很脏，杰克还被打成了黑眼圈

sentences.en: He was holding a bottle, but the milk had curdled inside
sentences.zh: 他手里拿着奶瓶，但里面的奶已经变质了

sentences.en: As far as Susan could see, there was nothing wrong with the twins
sentences.zh: 在苏珊看来，这对双胞胎本身并没有什么问题

sentences.en: Except that they were neglected
sentences.zh: 只是他们遭到了忽视

sentences.en: Susan scooped up Jack and held him for a little while
sentences.zh: 苏珊抱起杰克，哄了他一会儿

sentences.en: Before cleaning him up in the bathroom
sentences.zh: 然后带他去浴室清理干净

sentences.en: When she changed his nappy, she saw he had a rash and blisters So did Jill
sentences.zh: 当她给杰克换尿布时，发现他有皮疹和水泡，吉尔也是如此

sentences.en: It looked as though neither of them had been changed in a while
sentences.zh: 看起来他们俩已经很久没换过尿布了

sentences.en: After bathing the twins, Susan put them in fresh pyjamas
sentences.zh: 给双胞胎洗完澡后，苏珊给他们换上了干净的睡衣

sentences.en: Changed their bedding and got them fresh milk
sentences.zh: 换了床单，并给他们准备了新鲜的牛奶

sentences.en: She spent most of the night comforting them in their room
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，她大部分时间都在房间里安抚他们

sentences.en: When Marie and Gilbert Rosenthal returned early in the morning
sentences.zh: 当玛丽和吉尔伯特·罗森塔尔在清晨回来时

sentences.en: Susan told them how she'd cared for the twins
sentences.zh: 苏珊告诉他们自己是如何照顾双胞胎的

sentences.en: Marie was irate and started screaming
sentences.zh: 玛丽勃然大怒，开始尖叫

sentences.en: I told you not to do that I told you not to go upstairs You shouldn't have gone up there I told you not to bother the twins
sentences.zh: 我告诉过你不要那样做，我告诉过你不要上楼，你不该上去的，我告诉过你不要打扰双胞胎

sentences.en: Obviously you don't listen very well
sentences.zh: 显然你很不听话

sentences.en: Upset, Susan replied
sentences.zh: 苏珊感到很难过，回答道

sentences.en: I do listen, but they're just babies
sentences.zh: 我有听，但他们只是婴儿

sentences.en: Then she ran from the house without being paid
sentences.zh: 随后她离开了那个家，连工钱都没拿

sentences.en: Susan was scared She was haunted by the image of the neglected twins in their crib But also terrified that she had done something wrong
sentences.zh: 苏珊很害怕，双胞胎在婴儿床里被忽视的样子一直萦绕在她心头，她也担心自己是不是做错了什么

sentences.en: A few days later, a friend of hers who also lived in the neighbourhood
sentences.zh: 几天后，她的一位也住在附近的朋友

sentences.en: Told Susan that the Rosenthal twins had vanished
sentences.zh: 告诉苏珊，罗森塔尔家的双胞胎失踪了

sentences.en: No one seemed to know what happened to the two young toddlers in the late summer of 1965
sentences.zh: 似乎没人知道1965年夏末那两个蹒跚学步的孩子发生了什么事

sentences.en: Their cousin Melanie said that when her family paid their annual visit that year They were gone
sentences.zh: 他们的表姐梅兰妮说，那年她家进行年度探访时，他们已经不见了

sentences.en: Jack and Jill weren't discussed And Melanie's father Leonard told her never to mention them again
sentences.zh: 没人再提起杰克和吉尔，梅兰妮的父亲伦纳德告诉她永远不要再提他们

sentences.en: He said he suspected Marie and Gilbert had killed the toddlers And buried them in their yard
sentences.zh: 他说他怀疑玛丽和吉尔伯特杀害了这两个孩子，并把他们埋在了院子里

sentences.en: Due to their being intellectually disabled
sentences.zh: 因为他们有智力障碍

sentences.en: Leonard told Melanie that if she ever spoke of the twins to her other relatives It would start a family war
sentences.zh: 伦纳德告诉梅兰妮，如果她再向其他亲戚提起双胞胎，会引发一场家庭战争

sentences.en: Despite Leonard's suspicions
sentences.zh: 尽管伦纳德有此怀疑

sentences.en: Jack Rosenthal was found alive and mostly well on Friday, July 2, 1965
sentences.zh: 杰克·罗森塔尔于1965年7月2日星期五被发现还活着，且基本健康

sentences.en: Someone had left him in a pram outside McCrory's department store in Newark, New Jersey
sentences.zh: 有人把他留在了新泽西州纽瓦克市麦克罗里百货公司外的一辆婴儿车里

sentences.en: Newark was about a two hour drive north of Atlantic City where the Rosenthal's lived
sentences.zh: 纽瓦克距离罗森塔尔一家居住的大西洋城约有两小时车程

sentences.en: It was unknown who abandoned Jack at the store or where his sister Jill had gone
sentences.zh: 没人知道是谁在商店遗弃了杰克，也不知道他的妹妹吉尔去了哪里

sentences.en: Fifty years later, the man who had been raised as kidnap victim Paul Fronzac
sentences.zh: 五十年后，那个以绑架受害者保罗·弗朗扎克身份长大的男人

sentences.en: Discovered he had been born Jack Rosenthal
sentences.zh: 发现自己出生时叫杰克·罗森塔尔

sentences.en: Everything that Paul had been raised to believe about himself suddenly changed
sentences.zh: 保罗从小到大所相信的一切关于自己的事情突然改变了

sentences.en: He discovered that although he'd been brought up in the Catholic faith He was actually Jewish
sentences.zh: 他发现虽然自己是在天主教信仰中长大的，但实际上他是犹太人

sentences.en: Most shocking of all was the revelation that he had a twin sister
sentences.zh: 最令人震惊的是，他还有一个双胞胎妹妹

sentences.en: Paul had always felt a lack of belonging But not the sense that a part of him was missing As some people who have been separated from twins have reported
sentences.zh: 保罗一直有一种缺乏归属感，但并没有像一些与双胞胎分离的人所说的那样，感觉自己缺失了一部分

sentences.en: But now he knew about Jill, he was determined to track her down
sentences.zh: 但现在他知道了吉尔的存在，他决心找到她

sentences.en: Paul began reaching out to his biological relatives
sentences.zh: 保罗开始联系他的亲生亲属

sentences.en: Paul discovered that his older sister Karen had died in 2010 at the age of 47
sentences.zh: 保罗发现他的姐姐凯伦已于2010年去世，享年47岁

sentences.en: However, there were two surviving siblings and members of the extended family Paul could contact
sentences.zh: 不过，还有两位在世的兄弟姐妹和一些保罗可以联系到的远房亲戚

sentences.en: He received a mixed response
sentences.zh: 他得到的反馈不尽相同

sentences.en: Some, such as his aunt Barbara and cousin Melanie, were happy to talk with him
sentences.zh: 有些人，比如他的姑姑芭芭拉和表姐梅兰妮，很乐意与他交谈

sentences.en: Though they didn't know much about what had happened to him or Jill
sentences.zh: 尽管他们对保罗或吉尔的遭遇知之甚少

sentences.en: His biological siblings, Linda and Fred, were more reluctant
sentences.zh: 他的亲生兄弟姐妹琳达和弗雷德则比较抗拒

sentences.en: Fred said he had no memory of the twins and was shocked to even learn of their existence
sentences.zh: 弗雷德说他对双胞胎毫无记忆，甚至对他们的存在感到震惊

sentences.en: As Fred had only been a few months old when the twins disappeared
sentences.zh: 因为双胞胎失踪时，弗雷德才几个月大

sentences.en: His assertion made sense
sentences.zh: 他的说法合情合理

sentences.en: When he found out he'd had two more siblings he never knew about
sentences.zh: 当他发现自己还有两个从未谋面的兄弟姐妹时

sentences.en: Fred told Paul
sentences.zh: 弗雷德告诉保罗

sentences.en: I feel sick If you are Jack, I am so sorry that this has happened to you And I want to know what happened to Jill
sentences.zh: 我感到很难受，如果你真的是杰克，我很抱歉发生了这样的事，我想知道吉尔发生了什么

sentences.en: The pair initially exchanged a number of emails and discussed plans to meet in person But then Fred suddenly emailed Paul to say he wanted nothing more to do with him
sentences.zh: 两人起初交换了一些电子邮件，并讨论了见面计划，但随后弗雷德突然发邮件给保罗，说不想再和他有任何瓜葛

sentences.en: And asked Paul not to contact him again
sentences.zh: 并要求保罗不要再联系他

sentences.en: Linda also claimed to have no memory or knowledge of the twins
sentences.zh: 琳达也声称对双胞胎没有任何记忆或了解

sentences.en: As she was about four years old when they vanished, Paul found this strange
sentences.zh: 因为她失踪时大约四岁，保罗觉得这很奇怪

sentences.en: Linda told Paul that their father had been cruel
sentences.zh: 琳达告诉保罗，他们的父亲很残忍

sentences.en: The family dynamic she described was one of dysfunction With the members having drifted apart from each other over time
sentences.zh: 她描述的家庭氛围是功能失调的，成员们随着时间的推移渐行渐远

sentences.en: Like Fred, Linda initially seemed happy to get to know her long-lost brother Then suddenly, she stopped answering Paul's phone calls and refused to speak to him again
sentences.zh: 和弗雷德一样，琳达起初似乎很高兴认识这位失散多年的兄弟，但随后她突然不再接听保罗的电话，并拒绝再与他交谈

sentences.en: According to the biological relatives Paul tracked down, the Rosenthal family had a history of conflict And intergenerational trauma
sentences.zh: 据保罗找到的亲生亲属称，罗森塔尔家族有着冲突和代际创伤的历史

sentences.en: His cousin Melanie told him that her father, Leonard, who was Gilbert Rosenthal's brother
sentences.zh: 他的表姐梅兰妮告诉他，她的父亲伦纳德（吉尔伯特·罗森塔尔的兄弟）

sentences.en: Had been violent and abusive towards her and her mother
sentences.zh: 对她和她的母亲一直很暴力且有虐待行为

sentences.en: She no longer had a relationship with her father But Paul was able to track the now elderly Leonard down to a hospital where he was awaiting surgery
sentences.zh: 她已经不再与父亲往来，但保罗还是在一家医院找到了年迈的伦纳德，当时他正在等待手术

sentences.en: During a visit, Leonard initially told Paul that he'd met the twins a number of times But didn't know what had happened to them
sentences.zh: 在探望期间，伦纳德起初告诉保罗，他见过双胞胎几次，但不知道他们发生了什么

sentences.en: After a while, however, his memory seemed to return and he described a particular incident
sentences.zh: 然而过了一会儿，他的记忆似乎恢复了，并描述了一件特定的事情

sentences.en: Leonard and his parents had visited Gilbert and Marie Rosenthal's house unexpectedly
sentences.zh: 伦纳德和他的父母曾意外造访吉尔伯特和玛丽·罗森塔尔的家

sentences.en: Marie was angered by the surprise visit
sentences.zh: 玛丽对这次突如其来的造访感到愤怒

sentences.en: When someone asked where the twins were, she told them they were upstairs sleeping
sentences.zh: 当有人问双胞胎在哪里时，她告诉他们他们在楼上睡觉

sentences.en: One of the family members said they wanted to see the twins
sentences.zh: 其中一位家庭成员说想见见双胞胎

sentences.en: I'll bring them down, said Marie She headed upstairs, then reappeared with the twins
sentences.zh: “我把他们带下来，”玛丽说。她上楼后，带着双胞胎重新出现

sentences.en: She was grasping them by their wrists
sentences.zh: 她正抓着他们的手腕

sentences.en: Marie descended the stairs with the twin dangling from each of her hands
sentences.zh: 玛丽走下楼梯，两只手各拎着一个双胞胎

sentences.en: Leonard said it was as though she was carrying chickens by their necks
sentences.zh: 伦纳德说，那样子就像她拎着鸡的脖子一样

sentences.en: About four steps down, Marie deliberately dropped both of the children Then she stated
sentences.zh: 走到大约第四级台阶时，玛丽故意把两个孩子都扔了下去，然后说道

sentences.en: Here are the twins
sentences.zh: 这就是双胞胎

sentences.en: Leonard said that Jack jumped up and ran over to him
sentences.zh: 伦纳德说，杰克跳起来跑向他

sentences.en: The little boy held onto Leonard tightly as though he was scared
sentences.zh: 小男孩紧紧抓住伦纳德，好像很害怕

sentences.en: When Paul asked what happened to Jill, Leonard shook his head and replied I don't know
sentences.zh: 当保罗问吉尔发生了什么事时，伦纳德摇了摇头，回答说我不知道

sentences.en: Leonard's description of this incident reminded Paul of something he'd heard from another relative who wished to remain anonymous
sentences.zh: 伦纳德对这件事的描述让保罗想起了他从另一位希望保持匿名的亲戚那里听到的一些事情

sentences.en: This person had heard that something bad had happened to the twins
sentences.zh: 此人听说双胞胎发生了一些不好的事情

sentences.en: One of them had been dropped and both had subsequently disappeared
sentences.zh: 其中一个被扔了下去，随后两人都失踪了

sentences.en: This relative asked Gilbert's mother once or twice what had happened to the twins She would only say
sentences.zh: 这位亲戚曾一两次问过吉尔伯特的母亲双胞胎发生了什么事，她只会说

sentences.en: We don't discuss that
sentences.zh: 我们不讨论那个

sentences.en: Paul tried to piece together what might have happened to him and Jill based on the broken recollections he'd collected
sentences.zh: 保罗试图根据他收集到的零碎记忆，拼凑出他和吉尔可能发生了什么

sentences.en: It seemed that the household he was born into had been an unhappy and struggling one
sentences.zh: 他出生的家庭似乎是一个不快乐且挣扎的家庭

sentences.en: Multiple witnesses told him that his mother, Marie Rosenthal had found having so many young children difficult and drank frequently as a result
sentences.zh: 多位证人告诉他，他的母亲玛丽·罗森塔尔觉得抚养这么多小孩很困难，因此经常酗酒

sentences.en: Marie had told one relative
sentences.zh: 玛丽曾告诉一位亲戚

sentences.en: Every year I get pregnant and have another baby and I really don't like it
sentences.zh: 我每年都怀孕生孩子，我真的很不喜欢这样

sentences.en: When they lost their home and Gilbert temporarily abandoned his family
sentences.zh: 当他们失去家园，吉尔伯特暂时抛弃了家庭时

sentences.en: Marie's struggles intensified For some reason, Jack and Jill had borne the brunt of their parents' frustration and abuse
sentences.zh: 玛丽的挣扎加剧了，出于某种原因，杰克和吉尔成了父母挫败感和虐待的主要承受者

sentences.en: Some relatives believed or were told the children were intellectually disabled which was not true
sentences.zh: 一些亲戚认为或被告知孩子们有智力障碍，但这并非事实

sentences.en: Paul thought it was interesting that Jack had a black eye when Susan babysat him
sentences.zh: 保罗觉得很有趣的是，苏珊当保姆时，杰克就有一只黑眼圈

sentences.en: Remnants of a bruised eye were visible on his face when he was found outside McCrory's department store in July 1965
sentences.zh: 1965年7月他在麦克罗里百货公司外被发现时，脸上还能看到淤青的痕迹

sentences.en: Perhaps this meant he'd been abandoned just a few days after Susan had found the twins in an appalling state
sentences.zh: 也许这意味着他在苏珊发现双胞胎处于糟糕状态后的几天就被遗弃了

sentences.en: However, the fact that Susan hadn't mentioned the Rosenthal's youngest child, Fred meant that perhaps there were gaps or errors in her recollection of events
sentences.zh: 然而，苏珊没有提到罗森塔尔家最小的孩子弗雷德，这意味着她对事件的回忆可能存在漏洞或错误

sentences.en: Fred had been around six months old when the twins disappeared and yet Susan didn't remember him being present when she babysat
sentences.zh: 双胞胎失踪时弗雷德大约六个月大，但苏珊并不记得她当保姆时他在场

sentences.en: However, it's possible that the infant may have been staying with extended family on that night instead
sentences.zh: 不过，那个婴儿那天晚上可能正和亲戚住在一起

sentences.en: Paul believed that a particularly horrible event must have preceded his parents abandoning him
sentences.zh: 保罗认为，在他父母遗弃他之前，一定发生了一件特别可怕的事情

sentences.en: Perhaps they had either deliberately or accidentally killed Jill and felt they had to get rid of her twin as well
sentences.zh: 也许他们要么故意要么意外地杀害了吉尔，并觉得也必须除掉她的双胞胎弟弟

sentences.en: Multiple relatives reported hearing that Jill had been dropped
sentences.zh: 多位亲戚报告说听说吉尔被扔了下去

sentences.en: One recalled that she had supposedly been sent to an institution
sentences.zh: 有人回忆说她据称被送往了一家机构

sentences.en: Most of them agreed that the subject of the twins was forbidden within the family
sentences.zh: 他们大多数人都同意，双胞胎的话题在家里是禁忌

sentences.en: Paul wondered if Jill had been buried somewhere
sentences.zh: 保罗想知道吉尔是否被埋在了什么地方

sentences.en: In the first part of 1965, his family had lived with his paternal grandmother before moving into public housing
sentences.zh: 1965年上半年，他的家人在搬进公共住房之前曾与他的祖母住在一起

sentences.en: His grandmother's property was now an empty lot
sentences.zh: 他祖母的房产现在是一块空地

sentences.en: A radar sweep of the lot indicated a disturbance in the soil right at the point where the backyard began
sentences.zh: 对该地块的雷达扫描显示，就在后院开始的地方，土壤有扰动

sentences.en: Paul obtained permission from the lot's owner to dig it up and get some help from a construction crew
sentences.zh: 保罗获得了地主的许可，并从施工队那里得到了一些帮助，开始挖掘

sentences.en: They cleared a hole that was six feet wide and deep
sentences.zh: 他们清理出了一个六英尺宽、六英尺深的洞

sentences.en: Eventually, they found something
sentences.zh: 最终，他们发现了一些东西

sentences.en: A bone
sentences.zh: 一块骨头

sentences.en: Ten more fragments followed
sentences.zh: 随后又发现了十块碎片

sentences.en: Paul found an expert to examine the bones
sentences.zh: 保罗找了一位专家来检查这些骨头

sentences.en: It turned out that all were animal bones and had most likely been used in making soup
sentences.zh: 结果证明它们都是动物骨头，很可能是用来煮汤的

sentences.en: He was told that he had little hope of ever finding Jill's remains
sentences.zh: 他被告知找到吉尔遗骸的希望渺茫

sentences.en: The bones of a child around two years old aren't yet fully formed and would have most likely disintegrated after such a long time
sentences.zh: 两岁左右孩子的骨头还没有完全发育，经过这么长时间很可能已经分解了

sentences.en: Another aspect of the 50-year-old mystery remained unsolved
sentences.zh: 这个50年之久的谜团的另一个方面仍然悬而未决

sentences.en: Paul had learnt his own identity and origins But the truth of what had happened to the real Paul Fronzac after being kidnapped from Michael Rees Hospital was still unknown
sentences.zh: 保罗了解了自己的身份和出身，但真正的保罗·弗朗扎克在迈克尔·里斯医院被绑架后到底发生了什么，仍然不得而知

sentences.en: The FBI had reopened the case after Paul went public with his story but no news or developments had come from that
sentences.zh: 保罗公开自己的故事后，联邦调查局重启了此案，但没有任何消息或进展

sentences.en: Several more years passed Then one day in January 2019
sentences.zh: 又过了几年，2019年1月的一天

sentences.en: Paul received an email with the subject line
sentences.zh: 保罗收到了一封邮件，主题行写着

sentences.en: This is the baby you're looking for
sentences.zh: 这就是你要找的那个婴儿

sentences.en: It was from an anonymous tipster They informed Paul that a 36-year-old woman from Michigan named Julie had uploaded her DNA to a genealogy database
sentences.zh: 邮件来自一位匿名举报人，他们告知保罗，一位名叫朱莉的36岁密歇根州女性将她的DNA上传到了一个家谱数据库

sentences.en: The database had matched Julie with a genetic relative who was also on the website
sentences.zh: 数据库将朱莉与网站上的另一位遗传亲属进行了匹配

sentences.en: Paul's brother, Dave Fronzac
sentences.zh: 保罗的兄弟，戴夫·弗朗扎克

sentences.en: It turned out that Dave was Julie's uncle on her father's side
sentences.zh: 事实证明，戴夫是朱莉父亲那边的叔叔

sentences.en: Her father was the real Paul Fronzac
