sentences.zh: 她的父亲就是真正的保罗·弗朗扎克

sentences.en: This revelation was shocking to Julie and she hadn't told her father about it yet
sentences.zh: 这个发现让朱莉感到震惊，她还没有告诉她的父亲

sentences.en: As far as he knew, he was Kevin Beatty and his mother was a woman named Lorraine Fountain
sentences.zh: 据他所知，他是凯文·比蒂，他的母亲是一位名叫洛林·方丹的女性

sentences.en: Lorraine's parents had immigrated to the United States from Russia and Lithuania
sentences.zh: 洛林的父母从俄罗斯和立陶宛移民到美国

sentences.en: They decided to make Chicago their home and raised their family there
sentences.zh: 他们决定以芝加哥为家，并在那里抚养孩子

sentences.en: Lorraine was born in 1921 and spent much of her life in Chicago and the nearby state of Michigan
sentences.zh: 洛林出生于1921年，一生大部分时间都在芝加哥和附近的密歇根州度过

sentences.en: Lorraine married at the age of 19 in 1940 and soon had two children
sentences.zh: 洛林在1940年19岁时结婚，很快有了两个孩子

sentences.en: Norma Ray and Joe Bowers She divorced and remarried in 1951 but that relationship also failed
sentences.zh: 诺玛·雷和乔·鲍尔斯。她离婚后于1951年再婚，但那段关系也失败了

sentences.en: In 1964, the year that Paul Fronzac was born and kidnapped
sentences.zh: 1964年，也就是保罗·弗朗扎克出生并被绑架的那一年

sentences.en: Lorraine was back in her hometown of Chicago
sentences.zh: 洛林回到了她的家乡芝加哥

sentences.en: She was now in her early 40s and was dating a doctor
sentences.zh: 她当时四十出头，正在和一个医生约会

sentences.en: All of a sudden, she abruptly left to live in Arkansas
sentences.zh: 突然之间，她匆忙离开去阿肯色州生活

sentences.en: The South Central State was in a completely different part of the country to the Midwestern regions Lorraine had always resided previously
sentences.zh: 这个中南部的州与洛林之前一直居住的中西部地区完全不同

sentences.en: Lorraine wasn't alone She had a baby boy with her who was named Kevin Beatty
sentences.zh: 洛林并不是一个人，她带着一个名叫凯文·比蒂的男婴

sentences.en: His surname wasn't explained but Lorraine told everyone that Kevin was her son
sentences.zh: 他的姓氏没有解释，但洛林告诉所有人凯文是她的儿子

sentences.en: When he was about 5 years old
sentences.zh: 当他大约5岁时

sentences.en: Lorraine took him back to Michigan where her other adult children lived
sentences.zh: 洛林把他带回了密歇根州，她其他成年的孩子住在那里

sentences.en: Lorraine's daughter was surprised to see her mother with a small child and asked
sentences.zh: 洛林的女儿看到母亲带着一个小孩时感到很惊讶，于是问道

sentences.en: Who's that kid?
sentences.zh: 那个孩子是谁？

sentences.en: Lorraine replied
sentences.zh: 洛林回答说

sentences.en: That's your brother
sentences.zh: 那是你的弟弟

sentences.en: Lorraine married a man named Robert Fountain and he became Kevin's stepfather
sentences.zh: 洛林嫁给了一个名叫罗伯特·方丹的男人，他成了凯文的继父

sentences.en: Lorraine and Robert were both heavy drinkers and this seeped into Kevin's upbringing
sentences.zh: 洛林和罗伯特都酗酒成性，这影响了凯文的成长

sentences.en: In high school, Kevin was shy but liked sports He played football and basketball but for some reason, Lorraine never attended his games
sentences.zh: 在高中时，凯文性格内向但喜欢运动。他打过橄榄球和篮球，但出于某种原因，洛林从没去现场看过他的比赛

sentences.en: According to those who knew them
sentences.zh: 据认识他们的人说

sentences.en: Lorraine was an angry person and Kevin was afraid of her
sentences.zh: 洛林是个脾气暴躁的人，凯文很怕她

sentences.en: After graduating school, Kevin began working as a machinist He also married and had three daughters
sentences.zh: 高中毕业后，凯文开始做机械师。他也结了婚，并有了三个女儿

sentences.en: Kevin struggled with alcoholism over the years
sentences.zh: 多年来，凯文一直受酗酒问题的困扰

sentences.en: His mother often purchased alcohol for him when he was in junior high and as he grew older, his substance abuse increased
sentences.zh: 他上初中时，母亲经常给他买酒，随着年龄增长，他的药物滥用情况也愈演愈烈

sentences.en: Friends described Kevin as a really sweet man when he was sober but when he drank, he was, quote, a nightmare
sentences.zh: 朋友们形容凯文清醒时是个非常贴心的人，但一旦喝醉，用他们的话说，简直就是一场噩梦

sentences.en: Kevin's drinking ultimately led to him
sentences.zh: 凯文的酗酒最终导致

sentences.en: Kevin and his wife divorcing
sentences.zh: 凯文和妻子离婚

sentences.en: Kevin's mother, Lorraine, died in 2004 at the age of 82
sentences.zh: 凯文的母亲洛林于2004年去世，享年82岁

sentences.en: There's no indication she ever gave Kevin any reason to believe that he wasn't biologically hers
sentences.zh: 没有任何迹象表明她曾给过凯文任何理由去怀疑自己不是她亲生的

sentences.en: After Kevin's daughters found out the truth of his paternity they were afraid to tell him
sentences.zh: 在凯文的女儿们发现他身世的真相后，她们不敢告诉他

sentences.en: They had not only discovered that his mother wasn't related to him but that he was a famous kidnapping victim
sentences.zh: 她们不仅发现他的母亲与他没有血缘关系，还发现他是一个著名的绑架案受害者

sentences.en: Several weeks after Paul had first heard from the tipster
sentences.zh: 在保罗第一次收到线人消息的几周后

sentences.en: Kevin's daughters had told him the truth and also informed the FBI
sentences.zh: 凯文的女儿们告诉了他真相，并通知了联邦调查局

sentences.en: Photos of Kevin as a teenager revealed a striking resemblance to his biological brother, Dave They had the same smile, eyes, and roundish face shape
sentences.zh: 凯文青少年时期的照片显示，他与亲生兄弟戴夫长得惊人地相似。他们有着同样的笑容、眼睛和圆润的脸型

sentences.en: Even their hair was styled identically parted so it swept over their foreheads
sentences.zh: 甚至他们的发型都一模一样，都是从中间分开，垂在额头上

sentences.en: There were other family similarities too
sentences.zh: 他们还有其他家族相似之处

sentences.en: Without realising it
sentences.zh: 在不知不觉中

sentences.en: Kevin had inadvertently followed in the footsteps of his biological father by becoming a machinist like him
sentences.zh: 凯文无意中追随了亲生父亲的脚步，像他一样成为了一名机械师

sentences.en: Kevin's father, Chester Fronzack, died in 2017 two years before Kevin's identity was discovered
sentences.zh: 凯文的父亲切斯特·弗朗扎克于2017年去世，比凯文身份被发现早了两年

sentences.en: But his mother, Dora Fronzack, was still alive She was excited to learn her kidnapped baby had finally been found and couldn't wait to meet him
sentences.zh: 但他的母亲多拉·弗朗扎克还活着。得知被绑架的儿子终于被找到，她非常激动，迫不及待地想见他

sentences.en: Then, three months later, in April
sentences.zh: 然而，三个月后的四月

sentences.en: Kevin was diagnosed with four brain tumours as well as lung and kidney cancer
sentences.zh: 凯文被诊断出患有四个脑肿瘤，以及肺癌和肾癌

sentences.en: He began chemotherapy treatment and was unable to travel
sentences.zh: 他开始了化疗，无法远行

sentences.en: In early 2020, Kevin was able to call Dora and have their first ever conversation
sentences.zh: 2020年初，凯文终于能给多拉打电话，进行了他们有史以来的第一次交谈

sentences.en: They had another call shortly after that and Dora held out hope that she might still be able to meet her kidnapped son
sentences.zh: 不久后他们又通了一次电话，多拉一直怀揣着希望，希望能见到她被绑架的儿子

sentences.en: But on Saturday, April 25, 2020 one day before his 56th birthday
sentences.zh: 但在2020年4月25日星期六，也就是他56岁生日前一天

sentences.en: Kevin passed away
sentences.zh: 凯文去世了

sentences.en: Dora told Paul that she felt a new kind of grief upon finally learning what had happened to her kidnapped baby
sentences.zh: 多拉告诉保罗，在终于得知被绑架儿子的遭遇后，她感受到了一种新的悲痛

sentences.en: Quote
sentences.zh: 引用

sentences.en: I'm glad that he was found
sentences.zh: 我很高兴他被找到了

sentences.en: I'm glad we finally got an answer But the thing that always used to make me feel better was the hope that whoever had him
sentences.zh: 我很高兴我们终于有了答案。但过去一直让我感到安慰的是，我希望那个带走他的人

sentences.en: would be able to give him more than he would have gotten from us
sentences.zh: 能给他比我们能给的更好的生活

sentences.en: I prayed he'd been that fortunate But from what I've learned I don't feel like he's had many opportunities in his life
sentences.zh: 我祈祷他能那么幸运。但据我所知，我觉得他这一生并没有得到多少机会

sentences.en: I remember thinking
sentences.zh: 我记得我当时想

sentences.en: Why would somebody kidnap him if they couldn't give him a really good life?
sentences.zh: 如果不能给他真正好的生活，为什么还要绑架他呢？

sentences.en: Although Paul had been found questions about his kidnapping remained It still wasn't clear who was behind the kidnapping Was Lorraine Fountain solely responsible?
sentences.zh: 尽管保罗被找到了，但关于他被绑架的疑问依然存在。目前仍不清楚是谁在幕后主使。是洛林·方丹一人所为吗？

sentences.en: Or had she purchased, taken, or been given Kevin by whoever stole him?
sentences.zh: 还是她从绑架者那里购买、带走或被赠予了凯文？

sentences.en: Lorraine's mother had been a nurse's aide leading to speculation that she could have obtained a nurse uniform that way
sentences.zh: 洛林的母亲曾是一名护士助理，这引发了人们的猜测，认为她可能是通过这种方式弄到了护士制服

sentences.en: However, her physical appearance didn't really match the kidnappers
sentences.zh: 然而，她的外貌特征与绑架者并不完全吻合

sentences.en: Witnesses at the time described the kidnapper as between 35 and 45 years old about 5 foot 5 inches tall and approximately 145 pounds
sentences.zh: 当时的目击者描述绑架者年龄在35到45岁之间，身高约5英尺5英寸，体重约145磅

sentences.en: She had a greying brown hair and a ruddy complexion
sentences.zh: 她留着灰棕色的头发，面色红润

sentences.en: Lorraine had been 42 at the time putting her in the right age range
sentences.zh: 洛林当时42岁，年龄范围倒是吻合

sentences.en: But she had been much shorter at just under 5 feet tall and one acquaintance who'd known her as a young woman said she'd looked like country music star
sentences.zh: 但她个子要矮得多，不到5英尺。一位认识她年轻时的熟人说她长得像乡村音乐明星

sentences.en: Dolly Parton
sentences.zh: 多莉·帕顿

sentences.en: A source close to Kevin said he had been certain his mother wasn't his kidnapper
sentences.zh: 一位接近凯文的消息人士称，他确信他的母亲不是绑架者

sentences.en: The same source told Paul that the mafia had been behind baby Paul Fronzak's abduction as part of a child kidnapping ring
sentences.zh: 同一消息人士告诉保罗，黑手党是小保罗·弗朗扎克绑架案的幕后黑手，这是儿童绑架团伙的一部分

sentences.en: According to this source
sentences.zh: 据该消息人士称

sentences.en: Lorraine was acquainted with some mob bosses and had a role caring for these children until they were placed with new families
sentences.zh: 洛林认识一些黑帮头目，并负责照看这些孩子，直到他们被安置到新家庭

sentences.en: All of the publicity around Paul's kidnapping led to the mafia struggling to sell him
sentences.zh: 围绕保罗绑架案的所有宣传导致黑手党难以将他卖掉

sentences.en: Lorraine eventually agreed to take him and raise him when he was 3 months old
sentences.zh: 洛林最终同意在他3个月大时收养并抚养他

sentences.en: There is no evidence to support this claim
sentences.zh: 目前没有证据支持这一说法

sentences.en: After Kevin Beatty was identified as Paul Fronzak special agents from the FBI started making calls and conducting interviews with witnesses
sentences.zh: 在凯文·比蒂被确认为保罗·弗朗扎克后，联邦调查局的特别探员开始打电话并采访证人

sentences.en: The case remains open But as of mid-2023 the identity of Paul Fronzak's kidnapper remains unknown
sentences.zh: 案件仍在调查中。但截至2023年中期，保罗·弗朗扎克绑架者的身份仍然未知

sentences.en: The man who was raised as Paul Fronzak has kept his name despite learning that he was originally
sentences.zh: 那个以保罗·弗朗扎克身份长大的人，尽管得知自己最初的名字是

sentences.en: Jack Rosenthal
sentences.zh: 杰克·罗森塔尔

sentences.en: Paul's biggest question today is what happened to his twin sister Jill
sentences.zh: 但仍保留了这个名字。保罗今天最大的疑问是他的双胞胎妹妹吉尔发生了什么事

sentences.en: He believes it's possible that Jill was killed back in 1965 but also holds out hope that she is still alive
sentences.zh: 他认为吉尔可能在1965年就遇害了，但也抱有她还活着的希望

sentences.en: Perhaps Jack and Jill were both abandoned separately at the same time and to Jill wound up with a new identity like he did
sentences.zh: 也许杰克和吉尔当时被分别遗弃了，而吉尔像他一样有了新的身份

sentences.en: Paul was unable to question his biological parents
sentences.zh: 保罗无法询问他的亲生父母

sentences.en: Gilbert and Marie about the mystery as they had died in 1995 and 1997 respectively
sentences.zh: 吉尔伯特和玛丽关于这个谜团的情况，因为他们分别于1995年和1997年去世了

sentences.en: Both were killed by cancer and were 61 years old when they passed
sentences.zh: 两人都死于癌症，去世时都是61岁

sentences.en: Paul has received messages from a number of women who believe they may be Jill Rosenthal but so far DNA testing has failed to find her
sentences.zh: 保罗收到了许多女性发来的信息，她们认为自己可能是吉尔·罗森塔尔，但到目前为止，DNA检测未能找到她

sentences.en: In March 2020
Paul filed a missing persons report for Jill with the Atlantic City Police Department
sentences.zh: 保罗向大西洋城警察局提交了一份关于吉尔的失踪人口报告

sentences.en: He also commissioned an age-progressed composite sketch of what Jill might look like today
sentences.zh: 他还委托制作了一张吉尔今天可能长相的年龄推演合成素描

sentences.en: No photographs of Jill as a baby existed so the artist drew upon other photographs of the Rosenthal family as well as Paul's own appearance
sentences.zh: 由于没有吉尔婴儿时期的照片，艺术家参考了罗森塔尔家族的其他照片以及保罗本人的长相

sentences.en: Although he and Jill hadn't been identical twins his former babysitter
sentences.zh: 虽然他和吉尔不是同卵双胞胎，但他的前保姆

sentences.en: Susan Warlett had said they looked remarkably similar
sentences.zh: 苏珊·沃莱特曾说他们长得非常像

sentences.en: In September 2022 the National Centre for Missing and Exploited Children published and circulated the image of Jill that Paul commissioned
sentences.zh: 2022年9月，国家失踪与受虐儿童中心发布并分发了保罗委托制作的吉尔画像

sentences.en: As of the release of this case file episode the whereabouts of Jill Rosenthal remain unknown
sentences.zh: 截至本案卷剧集发布时，吉尔·罗森塔尔的下落仍然不明

sentences.en: Paul's journey to discover the truth of his identity and what happened to the real Paul Fronczak became something of an obsession for him over the years
sentences.zh: 多年来，保罗探寻自己真实身份以及真正的保罗·弗朗扎克遭遇的真相，已成为他的一种执念

sentences.en: He says that his preoccupation with the case ultimately led to the breakdown of his marriage but he felt obligated to resolve the mystery
sentences.zh: 他说，他对这个案件的沉迷最终导致了他的婚姻破裂，但他觉得有义务解开这个谜团

sentences.en: He has written two books about the case and his own investigations titled
sentences.zh: 他写了两本关于此案和他个人调查的书，书名分别是

sentences.en: The Foundling and True Identity
sentences.zh: 《弃儿》和《真实身份》

sentences.en: For as long as he can remember
sentences.zh: 在他记事起

sentences.en: Paul felt out of step with those around him
sentences.zh: 保罗就觉得自己与周围的人格格不入

sentences.en: As an adult he found it hard to put down roots and would drift between jobs and relationships
sentences.zh: 成年后，他发现自己很难扎根，总是频繁更换工作和伴侣

sentences.en: He partially credits this tendency to a genetic predisposition as other members of the Rosenthal family had led similar lives
sentences.zh: 他将这种倾向部分归因于基因遗传，因为罗森塔尔家族的其他成员也过着类似的生活

sentences.en: But Paul mostly believes that his restlessness was due to lacking a sense of belonging
sentences.zh: 但保罗更多地认为，他的不安是因为缺乏归属感

sentences.en: In getting to know some of his biological relatives
sentences.zh: 在结识了一些亲生亲属后

sentences.en: Paul finally met family members who looked like him and shared his interests
sentences.zh: 保罗终于见到了长得像他并有共同兴趣的家人

sentences.en: One of his cousins was a talented musician and shared Paul's passion for music But Paul's real sense of belonging came when his daughter was born
sentences.zh: 他的一位表亲是一位才华横溢的音乐家，和保罗一样热爱音乐。但保罗真正的归属感是在他女儿出生时找到的

sentences.en: Paul's commitment to solving his family's mysteries was also done for her to give her more information about her own heritage and story And it was also done for the family
sentences.zh: 保罗致力于解开家族谜团也是为了她，为了给她提供更多关于她自身血统和故事的信息。这也是为了抚养他的家庭

sentences.en: who raised him
sentences.zh: 所做的

sentences.en: Paul's investigation initially drove a wedge between him and his adoptive parents who didn't want to dredge up the past
sentences.zh: 保罗的调查最初在他和养父母之间造成了隔阂，他们不想揭开过去的伤疤

sentences.en: But eventually it allowed Paul to grow closer to them and discuss things that had been left unsaid for decades
sentences.zh: 但最终，这让保罗与他们走得更近，并讨论了数十年来一直未曾提及的事情

sentences.en: Paul interviewed his mother Dora for his second book
sentences.zh: 保罗为他的第二本书采访了他的母亲多拉

sentences.en: During their conversation she told him about the first moment she met him as a toddler in New Jersey
sentences.zh: 在交谈中，她告诉了他她在新泽西州第一次见到蹒跚学步的他时的情景

sentences.en: Quote
sentences.zh: 引用

sentences.en: The truth is from that very moment I never really doubted that you were my son
sentences.zh: 事实是，从那一刻起，我就从未真正怀疑过你是我的儿子

sentences.en: Over the years I noticed the differences but even then I never questioned it I loved you and I was always proud of you so why would I question it?
sentences.zh: 多年来我注意到了差异，但即便如此，我也从未质疑过。我爱你，我一直为你感到骄傲，所以我为什么要质疑呢？

sentences.en: You were the son that we raised and that was that you were the son of Christ that you and there
sentences.zh: 你就是我们抚养长大的儿子，就是这样，你是上帝赐予的儿子，你和那里

sentences.zh: 的存在
